title.rendered: This 90-minute WWDC26 session reveals Apple’s AI vision for developers

content.rendered:
Apple is giving developers a deeper look at its AI strategy through a new 90-minute WWDC26 presentation recorded at the Steve Jobs Theater. The session explores the company’s latest AI tools, frameworks, and Xcode capabilities while offering a glimpse into the future of app development across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Vision Pro.

Although much of the presentation is aimed at developers, it also highlights the kinds of AI-powered experiences users can expect to see in third-party apps over the coming months.

Apple builds an entire app from a few prompts

One of the session’s biggest highlights is a 20-minute demonstration in which presenters create an entire app from a single prompt before refining it through a series of follow-up instructions.

The resulting WWDC badge tracker app includes 3D animations, holographic effects, and Visual Intelligence integration, showcasing how Apple’s latest AI tools can handle a significant portion of the planning, design, and development process.

The demonstration also introduces new capabilities in Xcode 27. The AI-powered development tools can ask clarifying questions, suggest follow-up prompts, and help map out an entire project before developers write a single line of code.

The presentation suggests Apple is moving toward a future where AI becomes a core part of the software development workflow rather than simply an assistant for writing code.

Siri AI, Foundation Models, and a trillion-parameter demo

The session goes beyond app creation and explains how developers can integrate the new Siri AI into their applications through Apple’s latest frameworks.

Apple also provides a closer look at the Foundation Models framework, which gives developers direct access to Apple Intelligence capabilities while maintaining privacy and on-device processing where possible.

The company demonstrates how Foundation Models work alongside the new Core AI framework and the upgraded MLX framework. Together, these technologies add support for third-party AI models and provide developers with greater flexibility when building AI-powered experiences.

The presentation concludes with one of the most impressive technical demonstrations of the session: a 1-trillion-parameter Kimi 2.6 model running locally in LM Studio across four Mac Studio systems connected through RDMA-over-Thunderbolt, the low-latency networking technology introduced with macOS Tahoe 26.2.

A glimpse at the future of Apple Intelligence

While the session is primarily designed for developers, it also offers a preview of where Apple Intelligence is headed beyond Apple’s own apps and services.

From AI-assisted app creation to deeper Siri integrations and support for third-party AI models, the presentation makes it clear that Apple wants developers to play a major role in expanding its AI ecosystem.

As these tools become available, users can expect to see more intelligent, personalized, and AI-powered experiences across the App Store.

If you’re interested in Apple’s long-term AI roadmap, this WWDC26 session provides one of the clearest looks yet at how the company plans to bring Apple Intelligence to developers and third-party applications.

Which WWDC26 AI feature are you most excited to see in future apps? Let us know in the comments below.

title.rendered: Here’s everything new for Apple Notes in iOS 27

content.rendered:
Apple Notes didn’t get the spotlight at WWDC 2026, but it quietly received some of the most practical upgrades in iOS 27. This includes four meaningful changes such as better note organization, deeper Siri AI integration, expanded Markdown support, and a refreshed interface that aligns with the refined Liquid Glass design.

None of these features is flashy on its own, but together they make Apple Notes feel smarter, more organized, and surprisingly more capable. And if you use note-taking apps like Notion or Obsidian, iOS 27 gives Apple Notes a stronger standing as your default workspace.

Here’s everything new in Apple Notes on iOS 27.

Divider lines finally fix one of Apple Notes’ biggest problems

If you’ve ever created a long note in Apple Notes, you’ve probably experienced the same frustration. Everything eventually turns into a wall of text. Formatting like different headings, block quotes, bold text, checklists, etc. help. But when a note grows beyond a few hundred words, finding specific sections becomes surprisingly difficult.

This is why divider lines might become one of the best Notes features in iOS 27. Apple now lets you insert horizontal divider lines anywhere inside a note, creating clear visual separation between sections. It sounds small until you start using it.

How to add a divider line

  1. Go to a note and tap where you want to add the line.
  2. Tap on the cursor again to open the edit menu.
  3. Now, select Insert Divider Line.

That’s it. The result is a clean horizontal line that instantly breaks up large blocks of content. This isn’t something revolutionary, but Apple should have added it years ago. I can already see this becoming indispensable for meeting notes, research documents, travel plans, and project trackers.

Siri AI finally makes voice notes worth using

For years, creating notes with Siri felt like a demo feature. You could tell Siri to create a note, but the experience was basic enough that most people ignored it.

iOS 27 changes that. With the new Siri AI experience announced at WWDC 2026, Notes gains much deeper integration with Apple’s assistant. Siri can now create notes, update existing notes, and organize information with more context without leaving the conversation.

For example, you can say: “Add today’s action items from Slack to my project planning note” or “Create a note with the key things to bring in potluck that Sarah texted.”

Instead of jumping through apps, manually opening Notes, finding the correct document, and typing everything yourself, Siri AI can do everything. The best part is I pasted some meeting materials into the Siri app and asked it to format the text into a professional report and then save it as a note. It handled the actions smoothly.

This is the first time Apple’s AI strategy feels connected to a real productivity workflow and I want more of such AI features.

Markdown support gets better, and power users will love it

Apple Notes has spent years existing in an awkward middle ground. It was simple enough for casual users but lacked many features that power users expected. Markdown was one of the biggest gaps.

Apple started addressing that with Markdown import and export support in the previous release. In iOS 27, the company is expanding Markdown workflows further, making it easier to move content between Notes and developer-focused writing tools.

Now, you can paste Markdown-formatted text in notes, and it automatically converts into rich text. So no need to format it again. In addition, Notes lets you copy content with plain Markdown syntax. Simply tap the cursor and select Copy as Markdown.

For writers, developers, researchers, and anyone who lives in apps like Obsidian, GitHub, or static site generators, it’s a meaningful improvement.

Image Playground upgrades make notes more visual

Apple is also bringing its upgraded Image Playground experience directly into Apple Notes. In iOS 27, you can generate high-quality AI images inside a note without jumping to a separate app.

What’s more interesting is that Image Playground now supports additional image styles, including photorealistic for more detailed and expressive results. This is a big step from the previous cartoon-style images Apple originally launched.

The visual refresh is small but noticeable

If you were expecting a complete redesign, you’re going to be disappointed.

Like the rest of iOS 27, Notes adopts elements of Apple’s evolving Liquid Glass design language. The changes are subtle but noticeable throughout the app. Icons have been refreshed, interface elements feel lighter, and shared notes receive clearer visual indicators.

One of the most welcome changes is improved visibility around shared content. Anyone who collaborates on notes with coworkers, family members, or friends knows how easy it can be to lose track of what’s shared and what isn’t.

When can you use these new Apple Notes features?

The new Apple Notes features are available now if you’re running the iOS 27 developer beta, which Apple released immediately after its WWDC 2026 keynote. However, as with most major iOS releases, the stable version won’t arrive until later this year.

If you don’t want to install beta software, you’ll need to wait for the public release of iOS 27, expected in September alongside Apple’s next iPhone lineup.

There is one important caveat, though. The Siri AI and Image Playground features, require Apple Intelligence support with English setup language. That means you’ll need iPhone 15 Pro and later models.

Apple Notes is becoming the best choice for more people

The most interesting thing about Apple Notes in iOS 27 isn’t any individual feature. It’s the direction Apple is taking. Divider lines improve organization, Siri AI improves capture, Markdown improves portability, and the visual refresh improves usability.

None of these features would headline a keynote on their own. Together, though, they make Notes significantly better. That’s why I think Apple Notes is becoming increasingly difficult to replace.

Which iOS 27 feature are you most excited about? Let me know in the comments below.

In case you missed:

  • All the new Safari features in iOS 27
  • iOS 27 vs iOS 26: What has changed?

title.rendered: 7 free mobile soccer games to play this FIFA World Cup season

content.rendered:
With the FIFA World Cup 2026 now underway, soccer fever is sweeping across the globe. For those who still can’t get enough of the beautiful game after the final whistle, there are plenty of excellent soccer games on mobile that can help satisfy that craving.

Whether you’re into realistic simulations or prefer arcade-style gameplay, mobile platforms offer a surprisingly diverse range of soccer games. Given below are some of the best free soccer games you can play right now on iPhone and Android.

7 best free soccer games for iPhone and Android

Whether you want realistic World Cup-style action, deep team management, or quick arcade fun, these free soccer games deliver plenty of excitement on both iPhone and Android.

1. EA Sports FC Mobile

This game is the perfect way to carry the legendary FIFA series, now known as EA Sports FC, in your pocket. It features various popular single-player and multiplayer modes, including Ultimate Team. Perhaps its biggest strength is its extensive licensing catalog, which includes a huge selection of national teams and clubs complete with official kits and crests.

Thanks to its licenses and dedicated tournament mode, it emerges as the most suitable option for soccer enthusiasts looking to recreate World Cup-style matches. Excitingly, its lineup of officially licensed national teams currently includes more than 50 countries.

Download on: iOS | Android

2. eFootball

Pro Evolution Soccer’s transformation into eFootball has fully taken shape over the years. In the process, it has become one of the most popular soccer games available on mobile. From online league matches to offline friendlies, it offers all the modes typically expected from a modern soccer title.

While gameplay has historically been a strong point of Konami’s soccer games, the lack of official licenses for many kits and logos remains a long-standing weakness. Unfortunately, the same is true for eFootball. However, for soccer purists and longtime PES fans, this shortcoming shouldn’t significantly impact the on-field experience.

Download on: iOS | Android

3. Dream League Soccer 2026

Before major console soccer franchises took mobile gaming seriously, there was Dream League Soccer. Thanks to that head start, the game has evolved into a credible competitor capable of challenging industry giants like EA and Konami.

Although Dream League Soccer lacks official team kits, it features an impressive roster of real-world soccer stars. More importantly, unlike EA Sports FC Mobile and eFootball, it also includes a club management component. You can upgrade everything from stadium capacity to training facilities, giving you greater control over your team’s development. This feature helps set it apart from the two biggest names in mobile soccer gaming.

Download on: iOS | Android

4. Mini Football

Mini Football comes from the iconic casual gaming studio Miniclip. It features a roster of cartoon-style soccer players who are clearly inspired by real-world stars. For example, Lionel Messi appears as Leo Nel, while Kylian Mbappé is reimagined as Donnie MFastest.

You can build your team and compete against friends or online opponents. Thanks to its arcade-style gameplay, it is highly accessible for players who have never touched a soccer video game before and remains a delight for casual gamers looking for quick matches.

Download on: iOS | Android

5. Score! Hero

Score! Hero is another casual soccer game, but it comes with a unique twist. Unlike most soccer games that are played in landscape mode, this one uses a vertical orientation, making it ideal for one-handed gaming sessions.

Instead of full real-time matches, Score! Hero presents soccer in a moment-by-moment format. Every action gives you time to decide your next move. You’re one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but a teammate is making a run into space. Do you take the shot or make the pass?

The fun comes from making the right decision in these bite-sized yet crucial match moments.

Download on: iOS | Android

6. Top Eleven 2026

If you’ve ever wondered what it’s like to manage a professional soccer club, Top Eleven 2026 provides a detailed simulation of that experience.

Building your starting lineup and implementing tactical plans form one side of the game, while signing real-world stars and developing young academy talents make up the other. The game also lets you customize your club and stadium, creating an even greater sense of ownership over your team’s success.

To put it simply, if you’re fascinated by the strategic and managerial side of soccer, Top Eleven 2026 is an excellent choice.

Download on: iOS | Android

7. Retro Goal

For those nostalgic for soccer games from the 8-bit and 16-bit eras, Retro Goal should be a welcome addition to your app library.

This pixel-art soccer game focuses primarily on attacking sequences, while defensive portions of matches are simulated through text updates. The result is a streamlined experience that emphasizes the most exciting moments of the game.

In addition to the on-field action, there are management elements ranging from tactical adjustments to stadium upgrades. All told, Retro Goal successfully combines multiple aspects of soccer into a charming retro package.

Download on: iOS | Android

Final thoughts

All of the games listed above are highly rated on both the App Store and Google Play Store and have built strong followings within the mobile soccer gaming community. What’s even better is that you can experience everything they have to offer without spending a penny.

When it comes to recommendations, soccer fans looking for an experience similar to what they watch on television should start with EA Sports FC Mobile and eFootball. Meanwhile, those who want to skip the learning curve and jump straight into the action should prioritize Mini Football and Score! Hero.

No matter which game you choose, these titles should be more than enough to keep most soccer fans entertained throughout the FIFA World Cup 2026 season.

FAQs

Is FIFA available on mobile?

Yes. EA Sports FC Mobile, formerly known as FIFA Mobile, is available on both iOS and Android devices.

Is PES available on mobile?

Technically, yes. eFootball is the successor to the Pro Evolution Soccer (PES) franchise and is available on mobile platforms. Konami officially transitioned from PES to eFootball in 2022.

Which is the best free soccer game for Android and iOS?

EA Sports FC Mobile (simulation), Score! Hero (casual), and Top Eleven 2026 (management simulation) are among the best free soccer games available across their respective genres.

title.rendered: iPhone 18 Pro’s smaller Dynamic Island could make Siri AI look right

content.rendered:
Apple’s new Siri AI on iPhone currently appears as a wide glowing pill around the Dynamic Island. A new design theory suggests that it may not be the shape Apple had in mind for the long term.

UI designer Lorenzo argued on X that Apple may have designed the new Siri interface with the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in mind, since the rumored smaller Dynamic Island would let Siri appear closer to a round orb instead of a stretched pill.

That is not a hardware leak by itself. It is a smart UI observation built on earlier iPhone 18 Pro rumors. Apple has not announced the iPhone 18 Pro, and it has not confirmed any Dynamic Island redesign.

The rumor depends on a smaller cutout

The idea only works if Apple’s next Pro iPhones really do shrink the Dynamic Island. Earlier leaks claimed the iPhone 18 Pro could make the cutout about 35% narrower, with tipster Ice Universe pointing to a width of roughly 13.5 mm.

That would be a visible change from the current pill-shaped Dynamic Island. It would also explain why Siri AI’s interface looks more natural on iPad and Mac, where it is not forced to wrap around a long camera and Face ID cutout.

The hardware side of this rumor has been floating around for months. Previous iPhone 18 Pro Dynamic Island leaks pointed to Apple moving more Face ID components under the display, leaving a smaller visible cutout for the front camera and related sensors.

Siri AI may be previewing future hardware

If the rumor is accurate, iOS 27 may be showing a software interface that fits the iPhone 18 Pro better than current iPhones. On today’s models, Siri AI has to expand across the Dynamic Island, so the glowing orb becomes a pill.

On a smaller cutout, the same animation could look more like the circular Siri interface Apple uses elsewhere. That would make the new assistant feel less like it is working around old hardware and more like it belongs at the top of the display.

This is still a cautious read. Apple often designs software across multiple current and future devices, but a beta UI does not confirm an unreleased iPhone design. The safer takeaway is that the new Siri interface has made the Dynamic Island rumor more interesting.

Apple is expected to introduce the iPhone 18 lineup this fall. Until then, the smaller Dynamic Island remains unconfirmed, and Siri AI’s pill shape is simply how Apple’s new assistant looks on current iPhones.

title.rendered: Apple says price hikes are unavoidable as AI chip costs soar

content.rendered:
Apple is preparing to raise prices across parts of its product lineup as soaring memory and storage chip costs continue to put pressure on the company’s supply chain, CEO Tim Cook said in an interview with The Wall Street Journal.

“Unfortunately, price increases are unavoidable,” Cook said, adding that Apple has tried to absorb higher component costs but can no longer shield customers from the impact.

Cook did not specify when the increases would take effect or which products would be affected. However, Apple’s next major hardware launch is expected in September with the iPhone 18 lineup and the company’s first foldable iPhone.

AI demand is driving up chip prices

The biggest challenge comes from DRAM and NAND storage chips, which are used in smartphones, laptops, gaming consoles, and many other consumer devices.

As companies such as Google, Microsoft, Meta, and Amazon continue investing heavily in AI infrastructure, demand for these components has surged. According to TechInsights, average prices for both DRAM and NAND have quadrupled since last year and are expected to continue rising through 2027.

Research firm TechInsights estimates that maintaining Apple’s current profit margins could add roughly $270 to the price of a future iPhone Pro model.

Cook highlighted DRAM as a particular concern, noting that more supply is being allocated to high-bandwidth memory used in AI servers, while consumer electronics manufacturers compete for a shrinking pool of available chips.

Apple is exploring ways to increase supply

Cook said Apple is willing to use its financial resources to help expand memory production, although he did not provide details about what those investments might involve.

At the same time, he ruled out building Apple’s own memory or storage fabrication facilities, saying the company prefers to focus on areas where it has the deepest expertise.

The rollout of Apple Intelligence adds another layer to the challenge. Features such as the redesigned Siri require additional DRAM, placing Apple in direct competition for the same memory chips that are contributing to the current supply shortage.

Several technology companies, including HP, Dell, and Nintendo, have already raised prices in response to higher component costs. Morgan Stanley also expects smartphone and PC prices in the United States to increase by approximately 15% this year.

Cook described the current market conditions as unlike anything he has experienced during more than four decades in the electronics industry, calling the rapid rise in memory prices “a hundred-year flood.”

If memory and storage costs continue to climb, consumers could see higher prices across a wide range of Apple products in the coming years.

Would higher prices change your plans to buy an iPhone, Mac, or iPad? Let us know in the comments below.

Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: Siri AI won’t show up on your iPhone until you do this

content.rendered:
Updated your iPhone to iOS 27 expecting Apple’s all-new AI-powered Siri, but found the same old voice assistant waiting for you? You’re not alone.

Many users assume installing the latest iOS 27 developer beta update is enough to unlock the latest Apple Intelligence features, but that’s not how Apple is rolling them out. From hardware limitations to language settings and regional restrictions, there are several reasons why Siri AI may still be missing on your iPhone.

The good news? Most of them are easy to check. Here’s everything you need to know if the new Siri AI experience hasn’t appeared on your iPhone.

Why Siri AI isn’t available on your iPhone

Unlike other iOS 27 features that become available immediately after an update, Siri AI is part of Apple’s phased rollout. That means installing the iOS 27 developer beta doesn’t automatically replace the existing Siri experience.

If the new Siri isn’t showing up on your iPhone, it’s usually because one of the eligibility requirements hasn’t been met. Here’s what you should check.

1. Your iPhone must support Siri AI

Running the latest iOS 27 developer beta doesn’t automatically make your iPhone compatible with Siri AI.

While iOS 27 can be installed on iPhone models starting with the iPhone 11 series, Apple Intelligence requires significantly more on-device processing power. As a result, the new Siri experience is limited to supported iPhones, including the iPhone 15 Pro and newer models, because of Apple’s on-device AI requirements.

Before trying anything else, make sure your device is one of the supported models.

2. Join the Siri waitlist

Just like Apple Intelligence at launch, the new Siri AI experience is available through a waitlist. Eligible users must request access, and once Apple approves the request, the required AI models are downloaded to the iPhone in the background. After the download is complete, the upgraded Siri experience becomes available automatically. Here’s how:

  1. Open Settings and head to Siri.
  2. Here, tap Try New Siri. A Siri with Apple Intelligence (Beta) banner will appear.
  3. Now, tap the Join Waitlist button underneath the banner.
  4. Next, tap Continue to confirm.

A successful waitlist request changes the New Siri section in Settings to “Joined Waiting List.” That’s the only confirmation you’ll get until Apple approves your account. Once the rollout reaches your iPhone, Apple sends a notification letting you know the new Siri is ready to use.

3. Check regional availability

Joining the waitlist doesn’t guarantee immediate access. Apple is enabling the new Siri gradually, with support limited to select regions and Siri languages during the beta period.

If the Joined Waiting List status isn’t changing, try setting your iPhone region to United States and switching Siri Language to English (U.S.). Several beta users have reported that these settings make the Join Waitlist option appear and help them receive access sooner.

Once Apple expands support to your region, you can switch back to your preferred settings without losing access.

What happens on your iPhone after you’re approved?

After Apple approves your request, the “Joined Waiting List” message disappears, and Siri AI begins rolling out to your iPhone. Your iPhone will automatically download the required AI models in the background, so you don’t need to reinstall the beta or manually enable anything.

How to check if Siri AI is finally live

Apple doesn’t leave much room for guesswork once your waitlist request is approved. The first sign is inside Settings → Siri, where the Joined Waiting List status is replaced by a Try New Siri option.

A quick glance is enough to tell the difference. The familiar full-screen Siri animation is replaced by a Dynamic Island interface that includes a Search or Ask field for both voice and text interactions.

You’ll also find a dedicated Siri app that keeps your conversations in one place, as well as a Siri tab inside the Camera app, letting you ask questions about whatever you’re pointing the camera at. If none of these additions are available, your iPhone is still running the older Siri experience.

Summing up…

Installing the iOS 27 developer beta is only the first step toward getting Apple’s new Siri AI experience. If the feature isn’t showing up, check whether your iPhone is supported, join the Siri waitlist, and make sure Apple Intelligence is available in your region and preferred language.

Once your request is approved, Apple will notify you and roll out the new experience automatically. Until then, the Joined Waiting List status in Settings is the only indication that your request is in the queue.

Did the new Siri AI show up after joining the waitlist? Share your experience in the comments.

title.rendered: What does the Punk Sprite do in Fortnite? Ability, variants, and how it works

content.rendered:
Since the launch of Chapter 7 Season 3, sprites in Fortnite have significantly changed the gameplay landscape and introduced new experiences for players. From granting better loot to reducing damage, sprites and their unique abilities have proven useful in online matches. However, the same cannot be said with complete certainty for one particular type of sprite known as the Punk Sprite.

To put it plainly, the Punk Sprite is as unusual as its name suggests. Its ability does not activate unless one specific condition is met. Even after meeting that requirement, the ability does not always work consistently during a Fortnite match.

Punk Sprite ability and variants explained

The Punk Sprite is not particularly useful until you upgrade it to Level 5. Once upgraded, equipping it gives you unlimited ammunition for your weapons at random intervals. In other words, a Level 5 Punk Sprite only occasionally provides this gameplay boost rather than offering it continuously.

When the Punk Sprite’s special ability activates, it does not visibly increase your ammo count. Instead, your ammunition count remains unchanged while firing, allowing you to shoot without consuming ammo. It essentially functions as though you are firing from a secondary magazine with unlimited ammunition.

In addition to the standard Punk Sprite, there are several special variants that provide their own unique bonuses.

Gold Punk Sprite

Ability: Grants bonus XP for eliminating opponents.

Gummy Punk Sprite

Ability: Provides 10% additional Sprite Dust when extracting.

Gem Punk Sprite

Ability: Reduces fall damage by 30%.

Galaxy Punk Sprite

Ability: Grants 20% more ammo while looting.

Final thoughts

While it may not seem particularly powerful at first, the Punk Sprite can be surprisingly helpful during chaotic Fortnite battles that involve extended firefights. Its unlimited ammo ability is especially useful when you are stuck in a prolonged gunfight or enter combat early in a match with limited ammunition.

Since this bonus only becomes available after reaching the highest upgrade level, getting the most out of the Punk Sprite requires some patience. Players who prefer immediate benefits may find greater value in other powerful sprites, such as the Duck Sprite or Demon Sprite.

FAQs

How do you use the Punk Sprite in Fortnite?

To use the Punk Sprite, equip it in your dedicated sprite slot. Once equipped, the selected sprite will appear on your character’s back.

How many Punk Sprite variants are there in Fortnite?

In addition to the base variant, there are four known Punk Sprite variants in Fortnite: Gold, Gummy, Gem, and Galaxy.

What other types of Sprites are available besides the Punk Sprite?

Other sprite types include the Water Sprite, Earth Sprite, Fire Sprite, Duck Sprite, Ghost Sprite, Dream Sprite, King Sprite, Zero Point Sprite, Demon Sprite, and Burnt Peanut

mainEntity.name: Which is the best free soccer game for Android and iOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: EA Sports FC Mobile (simulation), Score! Hero (casual), and Top Eleven 2026 (management simulation) are among the best free soccer games available across their respective genres.

mainEntity.name: How do you use the Punk Sprite in Fortnite?

acceptedAnswer.text: To use the Punk Sprite, equip it in your dedicated sprite slot. Once equipped, the selected sprite will appear on your character’s back.

mainEntity.name: How many Punk Sprite variants are there in Fortnite?

acceptedAnswer.text: In addition to the base variant, there are four known Punk Sprite variants in Fortnite: Gold, Gummy, Gem, and Galaxy.

mainEntity.name: What other types of Sprites are available besides the Punk Sprite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Other sprite types include the Water Sprite, Earth Sprite, Fire Sprite, Duck Sprite, Ghost Sprite, Dream Sprite, King Sprite, Zero Point Sprite, Demon Sprite, and Burnt Peanut

title.rendered: iOS 27 vs iOS 26: What has changed?

content.rendered:
iOS 27 is not another iOS 26-style makeover. iOS 26 changed how the iPhone looked with Liquid Glass. iOS 27 keeps that design, cleans up some of its rough edges, and puts most of the attention on Siri AI, Apple Intelligence, performance, and parental controls.

The short version: iOS 26 was the visual reset. iOS 27 is the smarter and more practical follow-up, but its best AI features still depend on your iPhone model, language, and region.

iOS 27 vs iOS 26 at a glance

If you only want the quick difference, this is the simplest way to read the update.

Design: iOS 27 fixes the iOS 26 look instead of replacing it

iOS 26 brought Apple’s Liquid Glass design to the iPhone. It changed controls, tab bars, app icons, widgets, the Lock Screen, Home Screen, notifications, Control Center, and several Apple apps.

iOS 27 does not throw that away. It makes Liquid Glass easier to live with. Apple says the update improves readability, contrast, and icon detail, and adds a slider that lets you adjust how clear or tinted the glass effect looks.

That matters because iOS 26’s redesign was the kind of change everyone noticed, even if they did not care about new features. iOS 27 is more about making that look less distracting day to day.

Siri AI is the biggest iOS 27 upgrade

The main reason iOS 27 feels different from iOS 26 is Siri AI. Apple has rebuilt Siri with Apple Intelligence so it can handle richer conversations, understand personal context, answer questions about what is on your screen, and take actions across apps.

In normal use, that means Siri should be able to find a detail from Messages or Mail, understand a photo or webpage you are viewing, draft or edit text, and continue a longer conversation in the new Siri app. Siri also gets a Camera mode, so you can point your iPhone at something and ask questions about it.

The catch is availability. Siri AI starts as a beta later this year, begins in English, and is not initially available on iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch in the EU. Apple also says Siri AI and other new Apple Intelligence features are not available in China while it works through regulatory requirements.

Apple Intelligence goes from separate tools to everyday apps

iOS 26 already had Apple Intelligence features such as Writing Tools, summaries, Genmoji, Image Playground, Live Translation, Visual Intelligence updates, and AI actions in Shortcuts.

iOS 27 pushes that further into apps people use every day. Photos gets better AI editing tools. Safari can group tabs and monitor webpages for changes. Passwords can help fix weak or compromised logins. Shortcuts can be created from plain language. Messages and Mail can suggest useful actions from context. Calls can surface relevant information when you need it.

If you want the full feature breakdown, see our list of new Apple Intelligence features in iOS 27. For this comparison, the important point is simple: iOS 26 introduced more AI tools; iOS 27 tries to make them feel connected.

Performance should feel better on supported iPhones

iOS 27 is also a performance update. Apple says app launches are up to 30% faster, new photos load in Photos up to 70% faster, and AirDrop transfers are up to 80% faster in its testing.

Those numbers will vary by iPhone, battery health, storage, and how you use the device. Still, the direction is useful. iOS 27 is not just adding AI features on top of iOS 26; Apple is also trying to make the system feel faster and smoother.

If you are on an older supported iPhone, this may matter more than Siri AI. A speed and reliability improvement is useful even when the newest AI features do not reach your model.

Compatibility: same iPhones, different feature limits

Apple lists iOS 27 support for iPhone 11 and later, including newer iPhone SE models. That is good news if your iPhone already runs iOS 26.

But do not confuse iOS support with Apple Intelligence support. Many iPhones can install iOS 27 without getting the full AI experience. Apple Intelligence in iOS 27 works on iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, and iPhone 16 models or later.

So the practical split looks like this:

  • iPhone 11, 12, 13, 14, and regular iPhone 15 models: You should get iOS 27, but not the full Apple Intelligence package.
  • iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, and iPhone 16 or later: You are in the main Apple Intelligence group.
  • EU or China users: Some new Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features may be delayed or unavailable at launch.

Check the iOS 27 supported devices list before updating if a specific feature matters to you.

Should you install iOS 27 or stay on iOS 26?

Stay on iOS 26 for now if your iPhone is your main device and you are only looking at the iOS 27 developer beta. Betas can break banking apps, battery life, calls, CarPlay, or smaller apps you rely on.

Install iOS 27 later if you want the public release, your iPhone is supported, and the new features are useful to you. The update is most exciting if you have an Apple Intelligence-supported iPhone because Siri AI, Photos, Safari, Shortcuts, and Passwords get the biggest changes.

If you already installed the beta and regret it, you can downgrade iOS 27 beta back to iOS 26, but it requires erasing and restoring your iPhone.

Final verdict

iOS 27 is better than iOS 26 on paper, but it is not better for everyone on day one.

If you have a newer iPhone and want Apple Intelligence, iOS 27 is the update to watch. Siri AI, natural-language Shortcuts, smarter Safari, better Photos tools, and Passwords improvements make it a meaningful step forward.

If you have an older iPhone, iOS 27 is more of a polish update: better performance, refined Liquid Glass, and some non-AI improvements. That is still useful, but it is not the same upgrade Apple is selling to iPhone 15 Pro and newer users.

For most people, the sensible move is easy: skip the developer beta, wait for the public release, and upgrade once the features you care about are stable in your region and language.

title.rendered: Best Apple devices to gift your dad this Father’s Day 2026

content.rendered:
Father’s Day is one of those occasions when finding the perfect gift feels harder than it should. Ties, wallets, and coffee mugs are nice, but if your dad loves technology or simply appreciates gadgets that make everyday life easier, an Apple device can be a gift he’ll use long after Father’s Day is over. 

To help you choose, I’ve rounded up the best Apple devices to gift your dad this Father’s Day 2026. 

How to choose the perfect Father’s Day gift 

I’ve included Apple product recommendations from each category so you won’t have to keep searching. 

Apple Watch: Keep your dad connected and healthy 

Apple wearables make fantastic gifts for dads who want to track their fitness, stay connected, or simply look stylish with a gadget on their wrist. My dad loves his Apple Watch SE 3 for everything from tracking workouts to answering calls on the go. 

  • Apple Watch Series 11 ($429 $329): Keep your dad’s health in check with the new hypertension notification and Sleep Score system. Also, the improved battery life, 5G support, and AI-powered Workout Buddy support both fitness and everyday convenience. 
  • Apple Watch SE 3 ($249 $219): Get most of the premium fitness tracking, heart rate monitoring, sleep tracking and watchOS 27 features in a lightweight and durable design within budget.  

Tip: Choose a band that matches your dad’s style—sporty silicone for active dads or stainless steel for a more elegant look. 

AirPods: Let Dad enjoy music and calls in style 

If your dad loves music, podcasts, or needs crystal-clear calls, AirPods are a no-brainer.

  • AirPods Pro 3 ($249 $180): With 4x Active Noise Cancellation, Heart rate sensing during workouts, Hearing Test and Aid support, and enhanced Siri interactions, it’s the best everyday companion for work, travel, and entertainment.
  • AirPods Max 2 ($549 $499): Gift the ultimate over-ear headphones with enhanced Active Noise Cancellation, improved high-fidelity sound, smarter Live Translation, and a stylish aluminum design.

Best Apple productivity gadgets for working dads

Whether your dad runs a business, works remotely, travels frequently, or simply likes staying organized, these Apple devices can make everyday tasks easier and more efficient.

  • MacBook Neo ($590): Apple’s newest lightweight laptop, offering reliable performance, all-day battery life, and a portable design. With the right accessories, it can handle everyday workloads.
  • iPhone 17e ($599): Get powerful performance, long battery life, and Apple Intelligence features at a more accessible price point.
  • AirTag 2nd Gen ($29): With improved Precision Finding and seamless integration with the Find My network, it helps keep track of important belongings and reduces everyday stress.

Power solutions: Keep dad’s devices charged

For dads constantly on the move, reliable power accessories are essential.

  • Apple MagSafe Charger ($39 $33): Easily snaps onto iPhones (iPhone 12 or later) for fast, wireless charging with a secure magnetic lock.
  • UGREEN MagFlow 10,000mAh Power Bank ($90 $60): With Qi2-certified 25W wireless charging, strong magnetic attachment, and a built-in USB-C cable and battery display, it makes keeping his phone powered up effortless.

Entertainment devices: Make downtime more fun

If your dad enjoys movies or casual gaming, Apple’s entertainment gear is perfect for elevating his experience.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd Gen) ($129): Delivers 4K HDR content with Dolby Atmos support and comes with a Siri Remote for easy navigation. Great for binge-watching favorites or catching live sports.
  • iPad Air 11-inch (M4) ($599 $549): It delivers impressive speed for multitasking, video calls, document editing, streaming, and even creative tasks like photo editing.

Tip: Consider gifting a subscription to Apple TV+ or Apple Arcade so Dad can jump into his favorite shows or games right away.

Smart home devices: Upgrade dad’s living space

Apple’s HomePods are perfect for enhancing smart home experiences. With “Hey Siri” support, Dad can control his home hands-free—from turning off the lights to checking the weather.

  • HomePod (2nd Gen) ($299): Offers rich sound and doubles as a smart hub for compatible smart devices like lights, locks, and thermostats.
  • HomePod mini ($99): Compact, affordable, and still packs impressive audio with Siri integration.

Tip: Pair the HomePod with HomeKit-compatible smart bulbs to create a cozy nighttime scene with automation features.

Still not sure? Go for an Apple Gift Card

If you’re unsure what to pick, an Apple Gift Card is a thoughtful fallback. It gives your dad the freedom to choose what he really wants—from the newest iPhone or MacBook to apps, music, or subscriptions.

Available in multiple denominations, these gift cards can be purchased online or in-store and used across Apple services and products.

Related: How to Redeem Your Apple Gift Card or App Store Card

Why these Apple gifts stand out

This curated list of Apple devices will surely cater to different tastes and lifestyles. No matter if he likes working out, listening to music, or automating his home, these gifts bring joy and simplicity to his daily life. When I gifted my dad AirPods, the smile on his face said it all—Apple devices truly make a difference.

And the best part? Apple’s intuitive ecosystem means Dad doesn’t need to be a tech genius. Everything just works seamlessly and securely.

Make your dad feel special with Apple gifts

The best Father’s Day gifts are the ones your dad actually uses every day.

I hope this guide helped you find a gift that’s practical, stylish, and guaranteed to make him smile. Whether it’s an Apple Watch helping him stay active, AirPods making his commute more enjoyable, or a MacBook Air powering his work, these Apple devices deliver long-term value that goes far beyond Father’s Day itself.

Don’t forget to add a personal touch, like a heartfelt message or a custom playlist. to make the gift even more meaningful. Here’s to celebrating all the amazing dads out there. Happy Father’s Day!

Want more gifting ideas? Check these links out:

  • Best Google Pixel 10 Pro Fold cases

@graph.name: Apple Watch Series 10
@graph.description: Features a bigger display, ECG monitoring, and fall detection. It’s water-resistant—ideal for dads who jog, swim, or like staying connected throughout the day.

@graph.name: Apple Watch SE 2nd Gen
@graph.description: A great choice for beginners. It includes most watchOS 11 features at a lower price point.

@graph.name: Apple AirPods Pro 2
@graph.description: With active noise cancellation, spatial audio, and a sweat-resistant design, these earbuds are perfect for daily use.

@graph.name: Apple AirPods Max
@graph.description: Premium over-ear headphones that offer immersive sound, strong noise cancellation, and a sleek aluminum design.

@graph.name: Apple HomePod 2nd Generation
@graph.description: Offers rich sound and doubles as a smart hub for compatible smart devices like lights, locks, and thermostats.

@graph.name: Apple HomePod mini
@graph.description: Compact, affordable, and still packs impressive audio with Siri integration.

@graph.name: Apple MagSafe Charger
@graph.description: Easily snaps onto iPhones (iPhone 12 or later) for fast, wireless charging with a secure magnetic lock.

@graph.name: Anker MagGo Power Bank
@graph.description: A compact, magnetic battery pack that sticks to the back of iPhones and provides portable juice wherever he goes.

@graph.name: Apple TV 4K 3rd Gen
@graph.description: Delivers 4K HDR content with Dolby Atmos support and comes with a Siri Remote for easy navigation. Great for binge-watching favorites or catching live sports.

@graph.name: Apple iPad Air 11-inch with M3 Chip
@graph.description: Powerful enough for streaming, gaming, or FaceTiming with the family. Lightweight and ultra-portable for use anywhere.

title.rendered: Snap launches “Specs,” a new pair of AI-powered AR glasses

content.rendered:
Snap has officially introduced Specs, a new pair of augmented reality glasses that combine AI, spatial computing, and a see-through display in a lightweight wearable design.

Announced by Snap CEO Evan Spiegel at AWE USA 2026, the glasses are designed to function as a wearable computer, supporting everything from immersive entertainment to productivity and AI-powered experiences.

Specs pack cameras, AI, and a built-in display

Specs are made from lightweight Swiss TR90 polymer and come in 47mm and 52mm frame sizes, weighing 132 grams and 136 grams, respectively. Snap also allows users to insert prescription lenses, making the glasses easier to share and customize.

The hardware includes two full-color cameras, two infrared computer vision cameras, and 6-axis IMUs that continuously feed data into AI-powered experiences. Two Snapdragon processors split the workload, with one driving the display and the other handling computer vision tasks.

The glasses feature a 51-degree field of view using stereo waveguide displays with automatic tint adjustment. Snap says the experience is comparable to viewing an 115-inch screen from 10 feet away.

Spatial speakers, a microphone array, hand tracking, gesture controls, and natural voice commands are also built into the device.

Battery life, AI integrations, pricing, and availability

Power is another area that has received a major upgrade. Specs offer up to 4 hours of mixed use, while the included charging case increases total runtime to around 20 hours. Earlier developer-only Spectacles lasted for roughly 45 minutes.

The glasses can stream videos, cast content, power virtual whiteboards, and run Snapchat Lenses. They can also connect to a phone, computer, or gaming system over USB-C and function as an external display.

Snap is also expanding Lens Studio with agentic development tools and integrations for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, while developers can build AI-powered experiences using OpenAI and Gemini APIs.

Specs are priced at $2,195 with a refundable $200 deposit and are available for pre-order starting today. The glasses will launch later this fall in the U.S., UK, and France.

Snap’s launch also puts it ahead of several competitors, including Apple. While Apple is reportedly developing true augmented reality glasses, they’re not expected to arrive for several more years. The company’s first smart glasses, rumored for late 2027, are expected to focus on AI features without an integrated display, leaving Snap with an early lead in the AR glasses race.

Would you buy AR glasses like Snap Specs, or are you waiting to see what Apple and other companies bring to the category? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

title.rendered: WhatsApp may soon let you send view-once text messages on iPhone

content.rendered:
WhatsApp already lets you send photos, videos, and voice messages that can be opened only once. Now, the same idea appears to be coming to text messages on iPhone.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is working on a view-once option for text messages in its iOS app. The feature is still under development, so it is not available to regular users or beta testers yet.

If it ships as currently spotted, the flow should be simple. After typing a message, users will be able to long-press the Send button and choose “Send as view once.” The recipient can open the message once, after which it becomes inaccessible.

It also lines up with a privacy direction WhatsApp has been circling for a while. The app has already tested features that could delete messages after they are read and give users a more private Incognito Chat for WhatsApp and Meta AI.

How view-once text messages would work

WABetaInfo says the option will work in individual chats and groups. It will not be available in channels, which makes sense because channels are built for broadcast posts rather than private, temporary exchanges.

The privacy protections also look similar to WhatsApp’s existing View Once system. The report says recipients will not be able to copy, forward, share, screenshot, or screen-record view-once text messages inside the app.

That does not make the message impossible to save. Someone could still take a photo of the screen using another device. Still, blocking the usual in-app actions would make quick forwarding and casual saving harder.

This is different from disappearing messages

WhatsApp already has disappearing messages, but that feature works more like a timer for chats. You can set messages to disappear after a period of time, such as 24 hours, 7 days, or 90 days.

View-once text messages would be more direct. Instead of changing the whole chat’s message timer, you could send one sensitive line that disappears after the recipient opens it.

That could be useful for things like a temporary passcode, a private address, a one-time note, or any short message you do not want sitting in a chat history. Until now, users who wanted this behavior often had to put text on an image and send that image as view-once media.

WhatsApp has not announced a rollout yet

WhatsApp officially extended View Once to voice messages in 2023, after earlier offering the feature for photos and videos. Bringing the same control to plain text would make the feature feel more complete.

For now, though, this is still a beta finding, not an official launch. WhatsApp has not announced when view-once text messages will arrive on iPhone or whether the feature will change before release.

title.rendered: Apple’s accessory lineup gets a colorful summer refresh

content.rendered:
Apple has expanded its accessory lineup with a collection of colorful new products, as brands such as Belkin, PopSockets, Mophie, Nimble, and Herschel introduce fresh blue, pink, and teal color options.

The seasonal collection is available through Apple’s online store and for in-store pickup, giving customers a wider selection of accessories just in time for summer in the U.S. and several other markets.

PopSockets Low-Pro joins Apple’s lineup

One of the newest additions is the Low-Pro model from PopSockets, which is the thinnest version of the popular MagSafe accessory to date.

At just 2.5mm thick, it still functions as both an iPhone grip and a kickstand while taking up less space than previous versions. The accessory is priced at $39.95 in the U.S. and is available in several of the new seasonal colors.

More accessories receive a colorful refresh

The update extends beyond PopSockets, with several popular accessory brands introducing products in brighter finishes.

Some of the latest additions include:

  • Mophie Knit Puck for AirTag
  • Twelve South PowerClip Power Bank & Charger
  • Herschel AirTag Charm
  • Nimble SharePower Portable Battery Charger
  • Scosche StrikeLine USB-C to USB-C Cable
  • Herschel Cloudform Burrard Organizer Tech
  • Belkin UltraCharge Pro 20K Power Bank with Integrated Cable
  • Twelve South AirFly Pro 2 Bluetooth Transmitter
  • Herschel Cloud Sling for iPhone

Apple has also expanded its accessory catalog with several products that are not part of the seasonal color collection. These include Logitech’s MX Master 4 mouse, Nimble’s Podium 3-in-1 wireless charger, and Twelve South’s PowerBug charger with Qi 2.2 support, all of which are now featured on Apple’s New Product Arrivals page.

The latest additions broaden Apple’s accessory selection across charging, travel, and everyday iPhone essentials while bringing brighter color options to products that have traditionally been offered in more neutral tones.

Whether you’re looking for a new power bank, AirTag accessory, cable, or iPhone grip, the summer refresh gives Apple Store shoppers a few more colorful options to choose from.

Which of these new Apple Store accessories would you actually buy? Let us know in the comments below.

title.rendered: How to Update Your AirPods to the Latest Firmware Version

content.rendered:
Updating your AirPods, AirPods Pro, and AirPods Max is essential to ensure you enjoy the latest features and improvements. Apple typically rolls out firmware updates automatically over the air, but you can force an update manually if necessary.

In this guide, I’ll explain how to update your AirPods firmware and check whether they’re running the latest version.

Table of Contents
  • How to Update Firmware on AirPods
  • How to Update AirPods Max Firmware
  • How to Check Your AirPods Firmware Version
    • Find Your AirPods Firmware Version on iPhone or iPad
    • Find Your AirPods Firmware Version on Mac
  • What Is the Latest AirPods Firmware Version?
  • Signing off…

How to Update Firmware on AirPods

In most cases, AirPods and AirPods Pro firmware updates happen automatically in the background without any notification. The updates are pushed over-the-air (OTA) when the AirPods are placed for charging or within the Bluetooth range of the associated iPhone, iPad, or Mac.

But in case you notice that AirPods are not updated as expected, you can manually force an update using the following steps:

  1. Place the AirPods in their charging case and connect the case to a power outlet using a Lightning cable or a Wireless charger.
  2. Make sure that your iPhone, iPad or Mac is connected to Wi-Fi and has more than 50% battery charge. Also, make sure Bluetooth is on and Low Power mode is off.
  3. Leave your iPhone, iPad, or Mac nearby. Make sure the case’s lid remains closed during the process.

It should complete the firmware update in the background, as there is no specific option to manually trigger it. After about 10 minutes, check whether your AirPods firmware has been updated. The latest AirPods firmware version will be found later in the post.

Note If you don’t own an Apple device, you can’t update your AirPods.

How to Update AirPods Max Firmware

Updating AirPods Max is similar to updating AirPods, but there are slight differences in the process. These over-ear headphones don’t need a charging case.

  1. Ensure the paired iPhone, iPad, or Mac is 50% charged and has Wi-Fi and Bluetooth enabled.
  2. If you have an iPhone or iPad, plug the charging cable into the AirPods Max, connect it to the power outlet, and keep it close to your device.
  3. If you have a Mac, plug the charging cable into the AirPods Max and connect them to your Mac.

Now wait for 30 minutes, then check your AirPods Max firmware version.

How to Check Your AirPods Firmware Version

After you complete the update, checking the current firmware version of your AirPods can help you confirm whether they are up to date. Here’s how to check it on your connected iPhone, iPad, or Mac.

Find Your AirPods Firmware Version on iPhone or iPad

To check your AirPods firmware on your iPhone or iPad, be sure to update your iOS or iPadOS to the latest version. Then do the following:

  1. Go to Settings and select Bluetooth.
  2. Select the info (i) button next to the AirPods.
  3. You can see the version of your AirPods under the About section.

Find Your AirPods Firmware Version on Mac

First, make sure your Mac runs the latest macOS, then do the following.

  1. Click on the Apple icon in the top-left corner of your screen and select System Settings.
  2. Click on Bluetooth from the left panel.
  3. Locate your AirPods in the list, then click the info (i) icon next to them.
  4. Check the Version displayed in the information window.

What Is the Latest AirPods Firmware Version?

Apple often updates the firmware of the AirPods models to enhance connectivity, sound quality, and battery performance, fix bugs and occasionally introduce new features like Spatial audio, head gestures, etc.

The recent 8B25 update set the stage for integrating Live Translation in the European Union in iOS 26.2. The prior 8A356 firmware on AirPods Pro 2 and AirPods 4 brought all the new iOS 26, iPadOS 26, and macOS Tahoe features, like Studio-Quality Voice Recording and a Camera Remote.

Moreover, the new Sleep Detection feature automatically pauses audio when you fall asleep, Charging Reminders provide alerts when your AirPods case is low on battery, and Keep Audio in Headphones ensures your audio doesn’t switch to your car. Also, it improves noise isolation and audio performance in phone and video calls.

So, you must check and update your AirPods to get the best experience.

Read more: Your AirPods may sound better than ever with iOS 27’s new EQ features

Here are the latest firmware versions:

  • AirPods Pro (3rd generation): 8B41
  • AirPods Pro (2nd generation) with MagSafe Charging Case (Lightning and USB-C): 8B41
  • AirPods Pro (1st generation): 6F21
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation: 8B39
  • AirPods 4: 8B39
  • AirPods (2nd and 3rd generation): 6F21
  • AirPods Max 2: 8E258
  • AirPods Max (USB-C): 7E108
  • AirPods Max (Lightning): 6F25
  • AirPods (1st generation): 6.8.8

For the latest details on firmware updates, be sure to visit Apple’s official website.

Signing off…

Keeping your AirPods up to date ensures that you get the best possible performance and access to new features. While the process is designed to happen automatically, knowing how to check and confirm the latest firmware is useful.

Also read:

  • AirPods 4 vs. AirPods Pro 2: Which one should you buy?
  • How to fix AirPods static noise quickly
  • How to change AirPods settings on iPhone or iPad
  • How to Prevent iPhone from Auto-Switching Audio from AirPods to Your Car

keyPoints.title: Automatic Firmware Updates for AirPods
keyPoints.explanation: Most AirPods and AirPods Pro firmware updates happen automatically over-the-air when they are charging or near your connected device, without notifications.

keyPoints.title: Manual Firmware Update Process
keyPoints.explanation: To manually update your AirPods, place them in their charging case, connect the case to power, ensure your device has Wi-Fi and sufficient battery, and leave them near each other for about 10 minutes.

keyPoints.title: Updating AirPods Max
keyPoints.explanation: Updating AirPods Max involves connecting them to a charged iPhone, iPad, or Mac via a Lightning or USB-C cable and waiting about 30 minutes for the firmware to update.

keyPoints.title: Checking Your AirPods Firmware Version
keyPoints.explanation: You can verify your AirPods firmware version on an iPhone or iPad through Bluetooth settings or on a Mac via System Settings and Bluetooth, to ensure they are up-to-date.

keyPoints.title: Latest AirPods Firmware Versions and Features
keyPoints.explanation: The newest firmware, like 8A356, introduces features such as Spatial Audio, Sleep Detection, Charging Reminders, and improvements in noise isolation, available on latest models.

title.rendered: iOS 27: All the new Safari features you need to know

content.rendered:
For years, Safari felt like the browser I used because I owned an iPhone. Chrome was superior when it came to Chrome extensions, while Edge was playing around with AI. Arc made browsing interesting again, whereas Safari was fast, private, and not quite exciting. That changes with iOS 27.

Apple is introducing new features for tackling tab overload, automating boring browsing activities, and monitoring websites without the need to refresh them all the time. After trying them out myself, I found that these were some of the most useful Safari updates from Apple ever.

If you spend hours researching, shopping online, comparing products, following stock updates, or open up dozens of tabs at the same time, the new Safari will definitely alter your way of browsing. Here’s everything coming to Safari in iOS 27.

1. Safari can automatically organize your tabs

Let’s be honest. Most of us start with three tabs and somehow end up with 37. This may include tabs for research, shopping, work, and some random articles we’ll “read later.”

Safari’s new automatic tab organization feature tackles that mess automatically. With the help of Apple Intelligence, Safari is able to identify open tabs and combine them into logical groups without requiring manual organization. Simply, go to the tab view menu and toggle on Automatically Create Topics. From here, you can also filter topics to see only relevant tabs.

For instance, I opened several flight and hotel booking websites and WWDC news tabs. Safari created two topic groups and sorted the tabs accordingly. As I added new tabs, Safari put them into existing groups or created new ones.

This matters because Tab Groups have existed for years but most people don’t use them because organizing tabs manually feels like work. If you’ve ever ended a day with dozens of unrelated tabs scattered everywhere, this feature alone may be worth the upgrade.

2. You can create Safari extensions using AI

One of Safari’s biggest weaknesses has always been its limited extension ecosystem compared to Chrome. Apple’s answer isn’t trying to catch up extension by extension. Instead, it’s letting users create exactly what they need.

Safari can now generate custom browser extensions that adapt web pages from natural language prompts. Instead of writing code, you can choose from pre-built actions like Boost Productivity, Improve Focus, Get Creative, and Develop and Design and simply describe what you want an extension to do in plain English. Safari then creates it using Apple Intelligence.

Imagine saying:

  • “Create an extension that saves recipes into a folder.”
  • “Build an extension that highlights coupon codes.”
  • “Create a tool that extracts product prices from shopping pages.”

And Safari generates it for you. Then you can allow websites where the extension will work. If Apple executes this well, it could be one of the most ambitious Safari upgrades and the smartest uses of AI in a browser.

3. “Notify Me” watches websites so you don’t have to

This is easily my favorite new iOS 27 feature. I keep refreshing websites for product restocks, price drops, event ticket availability, reservation openings, new content updates, and many more. Now, it’s no longer necessary because Safari will do it on its own.

With the new Apple Intelligence-powered Notify Me feature, you can ask Safari in natural language to keep an eye on a page for a specific change. It will alert you when it finds the matching update. Simply, tap the settings icon on any page, select Notify Me, describe your criteria, and set the tracking frequency like daily, weekly, or monthly.

I feel this might quietly become the most-used Safari feature. Most people currently rely on third-party services, browser extensions, or dedicated tracking apps for this. Safari is bringing the capability directly into the browser. That means fewer apps, less hassle, and better battery life.

4. Safari gets smarter password management

Apple is also improving how Safari handles passwords with a background agentic tool. Powered by Apple Intelligence, Passwords app can now go to supported websites, sign in using existing credentials, and update weak and compromised passwords with a single tap. This makes security maintenance much less painful.

Most users know they should replace weak or leaked passwords but very few actually do it. By simplifying the process, Apple removes one of the biggest barriers to better online security.

5. New Ask to Browse controls for families

Apple is expanding child safety features in iOS 27 with a new Ask to Browse feature. When enabled, children need parental approval before visiting a new website.

For families, this could be one of the most important additions in iOS 27. It gives parents greater visibility and control without completely locking down web access.

6. Safari is getting faster behind the scenes

The flashier features are getting the attention, but Apple’s performance improvements may end up benefiting everyone. According to Apple, Safari in iOS 27 delivers better power efficiency, faster web app loading, quicker JavaScript execution, and smoother graphics performance. Also, all the new AI features are made keeping privacy in mind.

This matters because a browser that’s faster, smoother, and more battery-efficient affects literally every website you visit.

The catch: Not everyone gets everything

There’s one important limitation.

Many of new Safari features, including Automatic Tab Organization, AI-generated extensions, and Notify Me, require Apple Intelligence. That means you’ll need a supported device, such as an iPhone 15 Pro or newer.

If you’re using an older iPhone running iOS 27 beta, you’ll still get Safari improvements, but some of the most advanced capabilities may not be available.

The feature I liked the most in iOS 27 Safari app

If I had to pick one feature that best represents Apple’s new direction for Safari, it wouldn’t be AI-generated extensions or even tab organization. It would be Notify Me.

For years, browsers have been passive tools. You open them, search, refresh pages, and check websites manually. Notify Me flips that model. Now the browser can watch the web for you.

That’s a subtle shift, but it’s potentially a huge one.

Final thoughts

iOS 27 doesn’t reinvent Safari. But it makes the browser feel smarter, more helpful, and less demanding of your attention. Automatic tab organization tackles browser clutter, AI-generated extensions open new possibilities, and Notify Me eliminates constant webpage checking.

Also, faster performance improves everyday browsing and better parental controls make Safari more family-friendly. For the first time in a while, Safari isn’t just catching up to other browsers. In a few areas, it’s setting a genuinely interesting direction for where web browsing could go next.

What do you think about the new features? Share your opinion in the comments below!

title.rendered: How to get John Wick’s dog in Fortnite

content.rendered:
The legendary assassin John Wick is back in Fortnite as part of Chapter 7 Season 3, Runners. This time, however, he isn’t arriving alone. Epic Games has also added John Wick’s dog as a companion that players can unlock through a special in-game quest.

Unlike many sidekicks that can be purchased directly from the Item Shop, John Wick’s dog requires players to complete a specific quest after gaining access to the current season’s Battle Pass.

Here’s everything you need to know about finding, rescuing, and unlocking John Wick’s dog in Fortnite.

How to unlock John Wick’s dog in Fortnite

Before you can begin the quest, you’ll need to purchase the Chapter 7 Season 3 Battle Pass, which costs 800 V-Bucks.

Once you have access to the Battle Pass, launch a match and begin searching for John Wick’s dog.

Although the dog’s exact location isn’t marked on the main map, an icon will appear on your mini-map whenever you get close enough to its spawn location.

Related: Best XP Maps in Fortnite: Codes and Tips

Where to find John Wick’s dog in Fortnite

John Wick’s dog can spawn at one of two locations during a match:

  • The Battlewoods
  • Sinister Strip

The Battlewoods location

If the dog spawns at The Battlewoods, you’ll find it inside the sewers located in the northeastern section of the area.

To reach the sewers, head beneath the bridge and take the stairs leading underground.

Sinister Strip location

If the dog spawns at Sinister Strip, you’ll find it inside the southernmost building.

Look for the black building marked with a gold logo and positioned behind a large decorative fountain.

Listen for barking

As you get closer to the dog, you’ll often hear barking sounds that can help you pinpoint its exact location.

Combined with the mini-map marker, this makes tracking down the companion relatively straightforward.

How to rescue John Wick’s Dog in Fortnite

When you find the dog, it will typically be locked inside a cage and guarded by hostile NPC enemies.

To complete the quest, you must:

  1. Defeat the first wave of enemies.
  2. Eliminate the second wave that spawns afterward.
  3. Interact with the cage.
  4. Free and pet the dog.

Once completed, you’ll unlock the associated quest rewards, including John Wick’s dog as a sidekick for future matches.

Tips for completing the quest

Fortunately, this isn’t one of Fortnite’s more difficult quests.

Unlike certain seasonal missions that feature powerful bosses or complex mechanics, the John Wick’s Dog quest primarily involves fighting standard NPC enemies.

A few tips can make the encounter even easier:

  • Keep moving to avoid being surrounded.
  • Use nearby cover during firefights.
  • Eliminate enemies from range whenever possible.
  • Reload and heal between enemy waves.

As long as you avoid getting overwhelmed by numbers, the quest should be manageable for most players.

Is John Wick’s dog worth unlocking?

For fans of the John Wick franchise, absolutely.

The companion helps complete the iconic duo and serves as one of the standout rewards introduced alongside Fortnite’s latest John Wick collaboration.

Since the quest is relatively straightforward and doesn’t require defeating a major boss, it’s one of the easier seasonal unlocks currently available in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 3.

  • Dark Voyager in Fortnite: Where to find and how to deal damage
  • Fortnite sprites: All types, variants, and abilities
  • Complete list of video game character skins in Fortnite
  • Every video game character skin released in Fortnite

title.rendered: Olivia Rodrigo coming to Fortnite? Here’s what we know so far

content.rendered:
For a long time, Olivia Rodrigo has been among the most highly requested celeb additions for Fortnite. If a new in-game tease is anything to go by, it looks like Epic Games may finally be ready to fulfill those fans’ wishes.

From Ariana Grande to Travis Scott, an array of popular singers have previously made their way into the online multiplayer title. And, as of now, Laufey is the central figure in Fortnite Festival, also receiving skins and other items themed around her. As things stand, the latest name on this list could possibly be that of Olivia Rodrigo.

Olivia Rodrigo Fortnite collab rumor explained

On June 12, Fortnite leaker @Luwwani stumbled upon new models of a tree and a knife in Fortnite’s game files. This was soon found out to be for a new map location, close to Sinister Strip, depicting a tree with a swing attached to its branch and a knife stuck in its trunk. Another X user, @Wensoing, saw its apparent connection to an impending Fortnite-Olivia Rodrigo collaboration.

Map change in game! Will be next to Sinister Strip

(via @Luwwani) https://t.co/YNX4jMxIjb pic.twitter.com/vf8Rk4AS2U

— Wenso (@Wensoing) June 12, 2026

This rumor grew stronger after popular leaker @FireMonkey corroborated it and shared that the said collab was “coming soon”. The post drew people’s attention to how both elements, the swing and the stuck knife, are elements that tease Rodrigo’s arrival in the shooter game.

On the one hand, the swing is a central element on the cover of the American singer’s latest album, titled “you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love”. On the other hand, the knife stuck in the trunk could be seen as a direct reference to the alternate cover of Rodrigo’s album. Moreover, both these things also feature heavily in the promotional images shot for the project.

Olivia Rodrigo x Fortnite – Coming Soon

image via @Luwwani & @Wensoing pic.twitter.com/ecXoeKHSKq

— FireMonkey (@FireMonkey) June 12, 2026

What’s more is that the day @Luwwani’s post sharing the newly added items surfaced online was also the day Rodrigo’s album hit the shelves. All these signs together have convinced a section of Fortnite players of Olivia Rodrigo’s much-awaited entry in the game.

Although more details about this rumored addition won’t become clear until the new update is live, that hasn’t stopped fans from speculating what this collab could entail. The chances of it simply bringing an Olivia Rodrigo skin to the Item Shop are somewhat higher than those of the 23-year-old musician being added to Fortnite Festival, as its current season doesn’t end until July 29.

Regardless, it will be interesting to keep an eye on the official Fortnite account for any updates regarding an Olivia Rodrigo collab. If this anticipated addition becomes real, Fortnite would have added yet another highly popular singer to the fold after introducing Lisa, Chappell Roan, and Laufey over the past several months.

Having seen gaming grow tremendously over the years, he believes video games are the most comprehensive form of entertainment and considers them to be art. On the odd days when he’s not slaying a boss or obsessively hunting for collectibles in his virtual worlds, he may be found watching football or superhero flicks.

title.rendered: Fortnite sprites: All types, variants, and abilities

content.rendered:
With the advent of Fortnite’s Chapter 7 Season 3, titled Runners, sprites received a big overhaul. From previously being the key to unlocking Epic-tier loot in Chapter 6 to now becoming a back bling-like item providing gameplay boosts, sprites are currently a more important part of this wildly popular game than ever before.

Besides changing their function in the new update, Fortnite devs have also introduced some new types of sprites along with their unique variants. Each of these sprites offers something different in terms of gameplay, making it pivotal to consider which sprite to equip during a match and when. Additionally, these can even be upgraded by performing certain in-game actions to boost the effect of their abilities.

During a match, Fortnite players can store up to 5 different sprites in the inventory and equip any one at a time to activate its ability. The following list contains all the sprite types, variants, and their associated abilities in Fortnite Runners.

Every sprite type in Fortnite explained

Fortnite Runners introduces 11 unique Sprites, each offering distinct abilities that can impact combat, looting, survival, and progression during a match.

1. Water sprite

Rarity tier: Rare
Ability: Replenish shields while standing in water

2. Earth sprite

Rarity tier: Rare
Ability: Obtain additional rare items when opening chests

3. Fire sprite

Rarity tier: Rare
Ability: Unleash a fiery burst upon dealing enough damage to the enemy

4. Duck sprite

Rarity tier: Epic
Ability: Replenish shields by doing an emote or jamming

5. Ghost sprite

Rarity tier: Epic
Ability: Unlock cloak for a limited time after reloading

6. Dream sprite

Rarity tier: Legendary
Ability: Unlock a new item at each level upgrade, with legendary loot unlocking at the highest level

7. Punk sprite

Rarity tier: Legendary
Ability: Has a chance of giving unlimited ammo at level 5; no benefits below that level

8. King sprite

Rarity tier: Epic
Ability: Increased damage for your pickaxe

9. Zero Point sprite

Rarity tier: Mythic
Ability: Spawns Shield Bubble Jr, an item that creates a small shield dome, upon consuming a healing item

10. Demon sprite

Rarity tier: Epic
Ability: Generates health and shields with every elimination

11. Burnt Peanut

Rarity tier: Mythic
Ability: Offers a chance to obtain more loot, including Mythic-level loot, with each elimination

Fortnite sprite variants explained

Each type of sprite, leaving out Burnt Peanut, can be found in five different non-base variants: gold, gummy, holofoil, gem, and galaxy. These variants provide additional passive benefits on top of the sprite’s existing ability. Given below is the description of what each such variant grants.

  • Gold: Gives additional XP for eliminations.
  • Gummy: Gives 10% more Sprite Dust when a Sprite is extracted.
  • Holofoil: Boosts the team’s chances of finding rare sprites from containers by 30%.
  • Gem: Fall damage is reduced by 30%.
  • Galaxy: Gives 20% bonus ammo whenever you pick up ammo.

Wrapping up

As the season has progressed, Epic Games has been hard at work to expand the current lineup of variants. As per the official schedule, a new sprite or a special variant is introduced in the game each Thursday.

Keeping that in mind, players can expect to find even more variants than those mentioned above during the latter stages of the Runners’ season. Such consistent sprite updates certainly incorporate a lot of fresh fun into the multiplayer game, in particular for those who are invested in finding new sprites and extracting them.

FAQs

How many sprites are there in Fortnite’s latest season?

There are currently 11 Sprites available in Fortnite Runners. All Sprites except Burnt Peanut can also appear in five additional variants beyond their base version.

When were sprites first introduced in Fortnite?

Sprites were first introduced in Fortnite Chapter 6 Season 1, which ran from December 2024 to February 2025.

Which sprites are the rarest in Fortnite?

Among the rarest Sprite combinations currently available are the Gummy Zero Point Sprite and the Gummy Dream Sprite.
