How to Redeem Arise Ragnarok Codes in Roblox

Follow these steps exactly to avoid errors:

  1. Launch Arise Ragnarok on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the game to fully load.
  3. Open the Shop menu on the left side of the screen.
  4. Enter the code exactly as shown.
  5. Click Redeem.

If the code is valid, rewards are applied instantly.

Looking for more freebies? Claim bonuses in Dungeon Hunters codes, redeem the latest Borderlands 4 SHiFT codes, or pick up powerups with our Ghoul Re codes guide.

Common Arise Ragnarok Code Redemption Issues

Even valid Arise Ragnarok codes can fail if they are not entered correctly or if the game servers are not fully synced. Most redemption problems are minor and easy to fix once you know what causes them.

  • The code has expired or was already redeemed on your account
  • Incorrect capitalization, extra spaces, or formatting mistakes
  • Copy-paste errors, such as missing characters or hidden line breaks
  • Trying to redeem codes during server lag or immediately after an update

If a code does not work, recheck spelling, remove extra spaces, rejoin the server, and wait a few minutes after major updates before trying again.

What Are Arise Ragnarok Codes and How Do They Work?

Arise Ragnarok codes are developer-issued promotional codes that can be redeemed inside the in-game Shop. When redeemed, they instantly grant rewards to your account.

These rewards directly impact gameplay:

  • Coins: Buy gear and progression items faster
  • Class Rerolls: Change your class without restarting
  • Stat Resets: Rebuild your character properly
  • Event Rewards: Limited-time bonuses tied to updates

Codes are released by CLGAMES during updates, milestones, and events. They expire to keep rewards time-limited and prevent long-term balance issues.

Benefits of Using Arise Ragnarok Codes for Faster Progression

Using codes gives you practical advantages without spending Robux:

  • Faster early-game progression
  • Ability to fix build mistakes instantly
  • Freedom to test different classes
  • Reduced grinding for coins and resets

Codes are especially valuable after updates or when learning the game’s systems.

Where to Find New Arise Ragnarok Codes Safely

Developers release new codes on their social platforms:

  • Official Arise Ragnarok Discord (code-list channel)
  • CLGAMES Roblox group page
  • Developer social media accounts (X/Twitter, announcements)

You can also bookmark this page, as we regularly update this guide with the latest working Arise Ragnarok codes as soon as they are released.

Codes are usually released during updates, milestones, and events.

FAQ

Are Arise Ragnarok codes free?

Yes. All codes are free and require no Robux or real money.

How often are new codes released?

New codes typically appear during updates and milestone events, sometimes multiple times per week.

Can expired codes be reactivated?

No. Expired codes usually remain permanently disabled unless officially re-released.

title.rendered: SpongeBob Tower Defense Codes (June 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest SpongeBob Tower Defense Codes on June 01, 2026

If you’ve ever wanted to build your dream team of SpongeBob characters and defend Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob Tower Defense makes that possible and a bit chaotic. But here’s the catch: it’s a grind-heavy game, and pulling top units or getting enough loot takes time. That’s where codes come in.

The developers regularly drop codes that give you free rewards like Mythic Chests, Gold Trait Rerolls, and Secret Treasure Chests. And if you’re level 10 or above, you can redeem these codes and boost your game instantly. Let’s walk through all the currently active codes, how to redeem them, where to find more, and a few extra things you should know about the game.

  • GetGudKid: Free Rewards (NEW)

How to Redeem Codes in SpongeBob Tower Defense

Redeeming codes isn’t available right away. You need to reach Level 10 in the game first. This encourages players to experience the game before collecting free loot.

Once you’re Level 10, here’s how to use the codes:

  1. Open SpongeBob Tower Defense on Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop tab on the left.
  3. In the shop menu, press the Codes option.
  4. Enter the code exactly as shown (they’re case-sensitive).
  5. Hit Redeem and enjoy your freebies.

If you enter a code with a typo, it won’t work; you’ll get an “Invalid Code” message. Best to copy-paste directly.

Where to Find More SpongeBob Tower Defense Codes

There’s no strict schedule for new codes, but here are a few places where developers drop them:

  • WonderWorksRB on Twitter/X.
  • The official Krabby Krew Roblox Group.
  • The Krabby Krew Discord server, where codes are sometimes shared during events and patch drops.

You can also bookmark this page and check back here regularly for updates.

Quick Tip: What Makes These Codes Valuable?

If you’re new to the game, here’s why these codes matter:

  • Secret Treasure Chests can contain rare or exclusive units.
  • Mythic Chests offer better odds in the gacha system.
  • Gold Trait Rerolls let you re-roll unit traits to optimize performance.
  • Magic Conches and Exotic Chests are premium items not easy to grind.

Using these codes can save hours of farming, especially helpful if you’re trying to get stronger units or build a top-tier team faster.

Browse our complete list of Roblox codes to unlock free rewards.

Bonus: What Are the Rarest Units in the Game?

There’s no official single “rarest” unit, but the S+ tier units are the hardest to pull and usually have the best stats. Some examples include:

  • Dream Gary
  • GG Rock SpongeBob
  • Cyborg Plankton
  • SpongeGar
  • The Quickster
  • Captain Magma
  • Sea Bear
  • Smitty Werbenjägermanjensen

These are extremely low drop-rate units, so save your best chests and rerolls for chances to get them.

Is SpongeBob Tower Defense Official?

Yes, this game is officially licensed and developed in partnership with the owners of the SpongeBob IP. That means all your favorite characters, from SpongeBob to Sandy to Patrick, are legit and legally used in-game. It’s not a fan-made copy; it’s the real deal.

If you’re ready to start building your Bikini Bottom dream team, don’t wait too long, these codes can expire at any time. Bookmark this page or check back weekly for the latest updates.

Want to stay ahead of the next update or boost your squad even more? Keep grinding, keep redeeming, and don’t forget to check out the Discord for insider news.

If you try to redeem a Basketball Zero code and it doesn’t work, don’t panic. Most issues are easy to fix. Try these steps:

  • Make sure the code hasn’t expired.
  • Restart the game or rejoin Basketball Zero and try again.
  • Only use codes from official sources (Roblox page, Discord, or trusted gaming sites).
  • Ensure your game is updated if the code requires a new patch.
  • Remember: Codes work only once per account.
  • If all else fails, report the issue via Discord or the Roblox group.

Pro Tips to Dominate Roblox Basketball Zero

  • Learn zone types, as some abilities counter others.
  • Master dribble control by using up to three dribbles per possession wisely to stay unpredictable.
  • Time your steals, avoid spamming, and position yourself to intercept or block instead.
  • Pass smartly to reset your team’s dribble meter and create open chances.
  • Pick top styles like Basketball God, Emperor, or Ace for better control and abilities.
  • Block effectively by positioning yourself in front of dunkers and learning opponent patterns.
  • Scan the court quickly to decide if you should drive, pass, or shoot based on defender positions.

Conclusion

Basketball Zero brings anime heat to Roblox courts. If you’re trying to rise through the ranks or just want cooler moves, these codes can give you the edge. But they won’t last forever. Redeem them while they’re active and stay sharp for the next drop.

Yes, they’re shared by the official devs. No risk at all.

No, each code works only once per account.

How SHiFT Codes Work

SHiFT codes are one time use rewards tied to your SHiFT account. When you enter a code, it claims the reward on your account and sends it to your Borderlands 4 profile on every linked platform. Golden Keys go into your backpack currency list.

Codes usually come from Gearbox social posts, Randy Pitchford on X, marketing emails, or events.

Golden Chests are found in major Faction towns:

  • The Launchpad
  • Carcadia
  • Belton’s Bore
  • The Lockaway

Each chest feels like a free pull in a loot machine, delivering rare gear that can change how your character plays.

How to Redeem SHiFT Codes In-Game

You can claim codes without leaving your session.

  1. Open Borderlands 4 and go to the pause menu.
  2. Select the SHiFT tab.
  3. Open Rewards.
  4. Enter your code and press Redeem.

If valid, your reward appears in your inventory. Golden Keys show in the backpack currency list.

How to Redeem SHiFT Codes Online

The browser method is useful if you’re not near your console.

  1. Go to the official SHiFT website.
  2. Log in to your account.
  3. Select Rewards.
  4. Enter the code and check it.
  5. Select your platform.

You can also scroll and see your full code history.

How to Create a SHiFT Account

You need a SHiFT account to redeem codes.

  • Visit the official SHiFT site.
  • Create an account with email or log in with Steam, Xbox Live, or PSN.
  • Confirm the email.
  • Link your platform under Gaming Platforms.

Always link the platform you play on so rewards go to the right character.

Bonus Rewards and Email Skins

SHiFT codes sometimes give more than keys. Cosmetics are common after events and promotions.

Before launch Gearbox ran a newsletter reward called Hazard Pay: a weapon skin sent to early subscribers. To get similar future rewards, opt in to:

  • News and promo messages from 2K
  • Gearbox newsletter

These options are in your SHiFT account under User Preferences.

Where SHiFT Codes Come From

SHiFT codes are always time-limited. They can drop from:

  • Randy Pitchford on X
  • Gearbox X account
  • Gearbox Facebook
  • Marketing emails
  • Community events

Because codes expire quickly, it’s worth checking trusted sites often. Many older codes listed online are already invalid.

Why Golden Keys Matter

A Golden Key run feels great. Borderlands 4 has new parts, new synergies between class builds, and legendary rolls that can define your whole route. Opening a Golden Chest saves hours of farming for players with limited time. It’s a bonus that rewards being connected to the Borderlands community.

So keep an eye on new codes on this page. A single drop might hand you a weapon that carries your build through a whole Vault session.

  • Attack on Titan Revolution codes
  • Project Egoist Codes
  • Type Soul Codes
  • Project Blue Lock Codes
  • Clover Retribution Codes

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Plants vs Brainrots Codes on June 01, 2026

If you grew up playing Plants vs Zombies, you’ll feel right at home in Plants vs Brainrots, a chaotic Roblox twist on the old classic. But instead of zombies, you’re up against goofy, fast-moving brainrots. The goal stays the same: defend your base with plants, but the vibe is pure Roblox. It’s messy, addictive, and way more fun with a few code-based freebies to help you survive those early rounds.

These codes give you a head start: free cash, potions, and grenades that boost your defenses without the early grind. Let’s walk through everything you need, from working codes to how to use them, plus where to find more as the game updates.

Active Plants vs Brainrots Codes

  • DISGUISE: Redeem for 1 Disguise Glasses
  • STONE: Redeem for 1 Medusa’s Head
  • STACKS: Redeem for 1 Lucky Potion
  • frozen: Redeem for 1 Frost Grenade
  • based: Redeem for 5000 Cash

Expired Plants vs Brainrots Codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to Redeem Codes in Plants vs Brainrots

You can’t redeem codes until you complete the short tutorial. Here’s how the process works:

  1. Launch Plants vs Brainrots and finish the tutorial (buy a seed and place it)
  2. Tap the red Shop icon on the left
  3. Scroll to the bottom of the shop menu and tap Codes
  4. Type or paste your code
  5. Hit the Claim button

That’s it. If the code doesn’t work, it’s either expired or already redeemed.

Troubleshooting Code Errors

If your code isn’t working, try these quick fixes:

  • Check spelling — codes are case-sensitive and spaces matter
  • Don’t reuse — most codes can only be redeemed once per account
  • Server delay — some codes only work after a fresh server update
  • Copy and paste — to avoid typos, don’t type manually

Still not working? It could have expired—come back to this page to double-check the status.

How to Get More Plants vs Brainrots Codes

New codes often drop during updates, community events, or surprise giveaways. Here’s where to check first:

  • Join the official Discord server
  • Follow the Yo Gurt Studio Roblox group
  • Bookmark this page and check weekly
  • Join 1 hour before updates — devs sometimes host admin abuse events that drop exclusive rewards

title.rendered: Project Blue Lock Codes (June 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Project Blue Lock Codes on June 13, 2026

Project Blue Lock is the kind of Roblox game that gets into your head fast. One great goal is all it takes to make you believe you can become the ultimate striker. But unlocking the best characters and traits takes spins, and spins take time. Codes fix that problem instantly. They give you a huge boost even if you’re a new player or someone trying to return after a break.

All Active Project Blue Lock Codes

  • NINJA: 5 Lucky Spins (NEW)
  • OTOYAUPDATE: 5 Lucky Spins (NEW)
  • SNEAKY: 20 Spins (NEW)
  • THENINJA: 20 Spins (NEW)
  • OTTOKUN: 10 Spins (NEW)

Expired Project Blue Lock Codes

1KLIKES, 20SPINS, ADMINABUSE, AIKU, AIKUUPDATE, BAROU, BETTERGAME, BETTERLIFE, BK, BOTTLEOFWATER, BRUTAL, BUGFIXES, CHEEKYTUESDAYS, CHIGIRI, COBRA, COLDDD, CURVESHOTS, DEFENDER, DEVOUR, EXTRACAUSEWHYNOT, EXTRACAUSEWHYNOT2, EXTRACAUSEWHYNOT3, FERNYAA, FIRSTQOL, FREEFREESPINS, FREELUCKYSPINS, FREEZING, GOALREACHED!, HERO, HIORI, HOMELESS, HYOMA, ICEMAN, IMPROVEGAME, INMYRANGE, ITOSHIRIN, JOINEVENT, KING, KINGOFTHEFIELD, KUNIGAMI, LOKI, LOKINEXT, LORENZO, LORENZOSFX, MADANURUI, MORESPINSPLEASE, NEWCHARACTER, NEWCHARACTER2, NEWCHARACTER3, NEWGEN, NEWRARITY, PACEONLY, PBL2RELEASE, PBL2TWITTER, PLEASEADMIN, PLEASEINEEDTHIS, PRINCESS, PXGMAESTRO, QOLUPDATESOON, READYFORSHIDOU, RYUSEII, SAE, SERPENT, SEVEN, SHIDOUU, SIX, SPEEDY, STRENGTH, SUBAA, SWISSTOSHI, THANKSLADS, THUUUNDER, TOKIMITSU, TWITTERWITTER, UHMISTHISOKAY, WANTSOMESPINS, WEBACK, WILDCARD, WINSOMEGAMES

How to Redeem Project Blue Lock Codes

Redeeming is simple and takes only a few seconds. You must join the Sub Studios Roblox group before redeeming.

  1. Open Project Blue Lock.
  2. Tap the Codes button at the bottom of the screen.
  3. Enter a working code.
  4. Tap Redeem to add the rewards instantly.

Tips For Faster Unlocks and Spins

Small habits make this game more rewarding.

  • Always redeem new codes before playing ranked, so your build gets stronger faster.
  • Save your spins for significant updates, since the strongest characters usually release with reworks.
  • Restart the game if a code doesn’t work, since the redemption window sometimes glitches.
  • Don’t settle for a mid-build. One lucky spin can completely change your gameplay experience.

Where to find future Project Blue Lock codes

Codes drop often and usually appear during significant character updates, patches and milestone celebrations.

  • Project Blue Lock Discord server.
  • Developer announcements.
  • In-game update notes after major patches.

Make sure to bookmark our site because we update this page the moment new codes drop, so you never miss free spins.

Project Blue Lock gets better when you feel your growth match after match. Codes make the grind smoother so you can focus on scoring goals, unlocking rare characters and playing your own version of the Blue Lock dream. Keep checking for new codes and build the strongest player you can.

How to Redeem Volleyball Legends Codes

Redeeming codes is simple once you know where to look. Follow these steps:

  1. Open the Volleyball Legends game on Roblox.
  2. Tap on the Shop icon at the bottom of the screen.
  3. Select the Codes option on the left side.
  4. Type or paste your code into the box.
  5. Click Use Code to claim your reward.

If the code is valid, you’ll see a green confirmation message. If it’s invalid, it means the code has either expired or was typed incorrectly.

Why Volleyball Legends Codes Might Not Work

Sometimes a code may fail even if you think it should work. Here are the common reasons:

  • The code has already expired.
  • The code was typed incorrectly. Codes are case-sensitive, so make sure every letter and symbol matches exactly.
  • Extra spaces before or after the code can cause errors.

To avoid problems, it’s best to copy and paste the code directly.

How to Get New Volleyball Legends Codes

If you don’t want to miss out on future rewards, here’s where to look:

  • Join the official Volleyball Legends Discord and check the announcements channel for updates.
  • Follow the developer @Protori_ on Twitter/X for surprise code drops during events or milestones.
  • Bookmark this article, and we will keep it updated so you won’t miss any new rewards.

Final Thoughts

Volleyball Legends codes are the easiest way to unlock spins, test new playstyles, and power up your character, whether you want to dominate as a spiker, blocker, or setter. Just remember, codes don’t last forever. Redeem the latest ones now, and keep checking official channels to stay ready for the next update.

How to Redeem Blue Lock Rivals Codes

It’s super easy, here’s how:

  1. Reach Level 10 in Blue Lock Rivals (play matches and complete quests to level up).
  2. Join the official Blue Lock Rivals Roblox group
  3. Launch Blue Lock Rivals on Roblox.
  4. In the lobby, click the Codes button at the bottom of your screen.
  5. Enter your code exactly as shown and hit Redeem.
  6. Enjoy your rewards!

Why Isn’t My Blue Lock Rivals Code Working?

Happens to me too, usually when I am juggling my iPhone and Mac and trying to redeem fast. Codes can be fussy, even when you do everything right.

Here’s your go-to checklist:

  • Typos and Spaces: Codes are picky. I copy from Notes and paste with Handoff, then I look for sneaky spaces at the start or end, especially if I pulled the code from Discord.
  • Code Expiry: Some codes disappear without a heads up. If it fails, I check the post date in announcements and recent tweets to see if that window already closed.
  • Eligibility Requirements: You must be Level 10+ and a member of the official group. I double check the account I am on, because I sometimes swap alts on my iPhone and forget.
  • Region/Server Restrictions: A few codes only work on certain servers or for brand new players. I skim the event notes and ask in Discord to confirm before I burn time testing.
  • Restart the Game/App: A quick restart helps more than you would think. I force quit Roblox on iPhone, reopen, and try the code again.
  • Update Your Game: Make sure you have the latest build. I open the App Store, refresh updates, and grab the newest version before I retry.
  • Try Another Device: If nothing sticks, I redeem on my iPad or Mac. Clipboard sync makes it painless, and it rules out a device bug.
  • Contact Support: Still stuck. Hit the in-game Help Center or the official Discord. I include a timestamp, a screenshot of the error, and my level so they can see the context fast.

Quick Troubleshooting Table

What is Blue Lock Rivals?

Blue Lock Rivals is a competitive football (soccer) game on Roblox, a place where you build your dream team with characters pulled from the Blue Lock anime world. With bold anime visuals, lively match cutscenes, and smart team-building, you will recruit and train iconic players, try new tactics, and face rivals from across the globe in real-time PvP matches on iPhone or iPad.

Key Gameplay Features

  • Recruit and Train Players: Collect fan favorites from Blue Lock and level them up through training and upgrades. I usually pour early points into a striker slot on iPhone, quick taps make the finish feel snappier.
  • Tactical Team Building: Mix and match formations, assign special skills, and build team chemistry that is hard to break. On iPad, the bigger view makes dragging roles and swapping players feel cleaner. 
  • Real-Time PvP Matches: Test your skills against real players in fast, action-heavy matches that reward timing and positioning. Touch controls feel tight, and on high refresh screens the motion feels extra smooth.
  • Spins System: Use Lucky Style Spins and Lucky Flow Spins to unlock new moves, playstyles, and cosmetics. Think pulls with a little suspense, made better with a quick Haptic Touch buzz when a good one lands. 

Who Plays Blue Lock Rivals?

This game draws a passionate crowd, mostly anime and sports fans, with plenty of Roblox players in the mix (ages 12 to 30, if you’re curious, and yes, tons on iPhone during commute hours). Whether you’re here for strategy, the rush of fast plays, or to collect your favorite strikers, you’ll find a lively, welcoming community in official channels and fan spaces, with tips flying in Discords and App Store reviews that read like quick sideline chats. 

What Are Blue Lock Rivals Codes?

Think of these as little gifts from the developers, special codes released during updates, milestones, or limited events. Enter one and you can grab free items like Lucky Style Spins, Lucky Flow Spins, and sometimes straight cash boosts. These codes give you a head start that would otherwise take a lot of grinding, and yes, I keep a pinned Note on iPhone so I can paste new codes in fast from Mac with Universal Clipboard. 

What Do They Unlock?

Blue Lock Rivals codes are special promo codes released by the developers during updates, milestones, or events. Redeem them for: 

  1. Lucky Style Spins: Unlock new character styles and moves. Run a quick match to feel the change before you invest resources.
  2. Lucky Flow Spins: Add new flow abilities and effects. Worth saving for patches that shift the meta, then roll when the pool changes.
  3. Cash/Cash Boosts: Extra in-game currency for upgrades. Great for power leveling a striker, and using Notes helps track spending if the grind starts pulling you in.
  4. Exclusive Rewards: Sometimes unique cards or cosmetics, often tied to events. Some are limited, so do not sit on them. 
Pro Insight: If you’re a planner (like me), save your spins for when new styles or flows are added to the game. That way, you can maximize your odds of landing something rare or meta-changing.

When Do New Blue Lock Rivals Codes Release?

I keep an eye out for new codes during:

  • Major updates or new content releases, I scan patch notes, App Store update logs, and Discord announcements on my iPhone and Mac.
  • Special occasions (anniversaries, holidays) devs often drop celebratory codes.
  • Big milestones (visits, likes, etc.)

More Ways to Get Freebies (Beyond Codes)

Don’t just wait for codes! There are plenty of ways to stack up rewards in Blue Lock Rivals: 

  • Daily Logins: Pick up cash, spins, and sometimes special items just for showing up.
  • Leveling Up: Get resources as you hit new milestones.
  • Quests & Achievements: Completing these means more currency and spins.
  • Special Events: Jump into seasonal or milestone events for exclusive goodies. 
  • Community Giveaways: Keep an eye on Discord and social channels, sometimes there are surprise drops!
Expert Tip: Time your code redemptions with in-game events or boosts. For example, use cash boosts during double-reward weekends, or spend spins right after new styles are added.

Where to Find New Blue Lock Rivals Codes

Never want to miss a code drop? Here is how I stay in the loop, and you can too:

  • Discord Server: The Blue Lock Rivals Discord is usually the fastest place for fresh codes, developer news, and giveaways.
  • Reddit: r/BlueLockRivals is great for tips, memes, and code sharing.
  • YouTube: Some gaming creators share codes in their videos.
  • Trello Board: Blue Lock Rivals Trello is regularly updated with new codes, patch notes, and event details.
  • Roblox Group & Game Page: Sometimes, codes show up in the Roblox group or as announcements on the Blue Lock Rivals game page.

Why join?

  • Get notified about new codes instantly, keep the announcements channel on alerts so I can paste a code from Notes in seconds.
  • Participate in Q&As, giveaways, and tournaments, add the date to Calendar and jump in from whatever device is charged.
  • Team up for in game events, match finder channels make it easy to build a squad fast.

Similar Games to Try

If you’re hooked on Blue Lock Rivals, you might also enjoy:

  • Azure Latch: A football game with anime style. The pace works for shorter sessions, and hopping in on 5G stays smooth on iPhone, even on busy networks.
  • Meta Lock: A fresh take on the genre with distinct mechanics. I test builds here when I want a rhythm change, then carry key ideas back to Rivals. 
  • Skillful: For players who want a different flavor of anime sports action. I run it on my Mac in Safari, controller plugged in, and the performance feels steady. 
Pro Tip: Set notifications for official accounts and bookmark this guide—trust me, you’ll thank yourself later.

Best Blue Lock Rivals Codes Ever (Highlights)

Some of the most popular codes from past events have included, and I still keep screenshots of the good ones in Photos so I can remember what I pulled:

  1. BACHIRA!!: 15 Lucky Style Spins, easy to bank a handful of early rerolls on iPhone, and the pull list still lives in a Notes log.
  2. REVAMP!: 10 Lucky Flow Spins, great for testing a fresh flow, run these right after an update to lock a build that can carry ranked.
  3. OTOYA!!: 15 Lucky Style Spins, another stash for cosmetics and moves, try one match first, then decide where to invest. 
  4. KING1.5M: 10 Lucky Spins, 10 Flow Spins, a balanced drop that lets you chase a style while rolling for a flow on the side.
  5. LUCKYCODE10: 10 Lucky Style Rerolls, 5 Flow Rerolls, especially handy during patch weeks when the pool shifts and you want a quick reset.

Redeeming codes regularly can speed up progress, set a small Reminder on iPhone so you do not forget.

Code Safety: Don’t Get Scammed

A quick word of caution:

  • Skip third party code generators, they are usually scams and could compromise your account. If a site asks for your Roblox username or wants odd installers, close the tab. Keep a content blocker on in Safari if you tend to go link hopping.

title.rendered: WhatsApp for mac could soon get Apple’s Liquid Glass refresh

content.rendered:
WhatsApp is reportedly working on bringing Apple’s Liquid Glass design language to its Mac app, making the messaging platform feel more aligned with the look and feel of modern Apple software.

The feature was spotted by WABetaInfo, which says the redesign is currently under development and not yet available to beta testers.

WhatsApp’s Mac app may get a visual refresh

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is preparing a new interface for macOS that more closely aligns with Apple’s Liquid Glass design language introduced in its latest software updates.

The redesign is expected to bring:

  • More translucent interface elements
  • Glass-like visual effects
  • Updated navigation components
  • An interface that feels more in line with modern macOS apps

The redesign is not particularly surprising, since WhatsApp’s Mac app already shares much of its underlying framework with the iPad version through Apple’s Catalyst technology.

As a result, incorporating more Liquid Glass-inspired components could help WhatsApp feel more at home alongside Apple’s latest software releases.

Meta has been gradually updating WhatsApp’s design

Meta has already been testing Liquid Glass-inspired changes in WhatsApp for iPhone, including updates to chat screens, navigation bars, reaction menus, and message controls.

Bringing those changes to Mac could make WhatsApp feel more integrated within Apple’s ecosystem.

Based on what has been discovered so far, the update appears to focus more on appearance rather than introducing major new features. It could make the app look more consistent with modern macOS apps that are gradually adopting Apple’s newer design language.

The feature is still under development, and Meta has not shared a timeline for beta testing or public availability. That means the final design could still change before it reaches users.

For now, it looks like WhatsApp for Mac could be the next part of Meta’s app lineup to receive a visual overhaul.

Do you like Apple’s Liquid Glass design style, or would you prefer WhatsApp keep its current look on Mac? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

title.rendered: New Apple TV and HomePod mini are reportedly almost ready, but Siri may be the hold-up

content.rendered:
Apple’s next Apple TV and HomePod mini may already be close to launch from a hardware standpoint. The bigger question now seems to be when Apple’s new Siri and Apple Intelligence experience will be ready to make them feel new.

According to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, the next Apple TV set-top box and HomePod mini are “nearly ready” and have been used by Apple employees for months. Apple has not announced either product yet, so this is still a report rather than confirmed launch timing.

The timing makes sense. Apple’s WWDC 2026 keynote is scheduled for June 8 at 10 a.m. PT, where the company is expected to preview iOS 27, tvOS 27, and its next wave of Siri and Apple Intelligence features.

Apple may be waiting for the new Siri story

Gurman’s report suggests the hardware itself is not the main blocker. Instead, Apple appears to be holding the devices until the software side is ready, especially the new Siri experience expected later this year.

That matters because Apple TV and HomePod mini both sit at the center of the home. A smarter Siri could make the HomePod mini feel less like a tiny speaker with voice commands and more like a useful home assistant. On Apple TV, better Siri could improve search, navigation, smart home control, and quick answers from the couch.

It also fits the broader iOS 27 Siri overhaul Apple is expected to show at WWDC. Recent reports point to a more capable assistant with a dedicated app, better context handling, and deeper system integration. If Apple wants its home devices to be part of that reset, launching them before the software is ready would blunt the pitch.

The hardware may be a practical refresh

The next Apple TV is not expected to be a dramatic redesign. Gurman says he would not expect huge hardware changes beyond the new chip, though the Siri Remote may also be refreshed in some form.

That still leaves room for a meaningful upgrade. The current Apple TV 4K dates back to 2022, and a newer chip could make the box faster, more efficient, and better prepared for future Siri, smart home, and gaming features. A better Siri Remote would also be welcome, especially if Apple wants voice search and assistant controls to feel central again.

The HomePod mini refresh is overdue in a more obvious way. The original model launched in 2020, and Apple has mostly kept it alive through color changes and software updates. A new model would likely focus on a faster chip and better wireless performance, while keeping the small design and $99-style positioning that made the mini easy to recommend. The latest report gives fresh weight to the long-running HomePod mini 2 expectations, but Apple has not confirmed the final specs.

WWDC should make the launch window clearer

The safest read is that Apple has the living-room hardware close to done, but wants the launch to line up with the bigger Siri and Apple Intelligence push. That points to a fall release window, assuming the software lands on schedule.

For users, the key question is not just whether Apple ships a faster Apple TV or a refreshed HomePod mini. It is whether Siri finally becomes useful enough to make those devices feel smarter in daily use. WWDC should tell us how close Apple is to that promise.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Anime Vanguards Codes on July 01, 2026

Chasing waves in Anime Vanguards, I always cash in fresh codes on my iPhone before a run. It takes seconds and drops free gems, coins, trait rerolls, and other boosts. New player or long timer, those freebies help when a tough wave stacks up. 

Below, you will find a live list of working codes, quick steps to redeem them, and a few ways I track new drops, so you keep the rewards flowing while you defend your base and climb the leaderboards.

All Active Anime Vanguards Codes

  • LagGone: 1000 RR, 200k IcedTea26, and 100 Summer Capsules (NEW)
  • 13.5: 50 Trait Rerolls and 5,000 Iced Teas
  • EternalAdversaries: 50 Memoria Shards and 5,000 Iced Teas
  • Gambler: 50 Trait Rerolls, 50 Memoria Shards, and 5 Rainbow Essence Stones
  • kat: Meme Code

Expired Anime Vanguards Codes

100KLIKES, 100KSUBS, 100MVISITS, 10KLIKES, 10MVISITS, 150KYT, 1DAYLEFT, 1MILLION, 1STANNIVERSARY, 1WEEKDELAY, 200KLIKES, 2026, 23RDPRESIDENT, 25MVISITS, 2DAYSLEFTBUTWORKINGFR, 2MLIKES, 300KLIKES, 300KPLAYERS, 3DAYSLEFT, 400KLIKES, 4DAYSLEFT, 500MVISITS, 5DAYSLEFT, 600KLIKES, 70MVISITS, 7WEEKS, 800KLIKES, ABOVEHEAVEN, ALMOST100K, ALSISBEST, ANGRYMAN, ANOTHERUNIT, ASTRAL, AURA, AV500KLIKES, AV50MIL, BUGDEMONATTACKED, BYEDIVALO, BYTES, CHAINSAWS, CLANWARSSEASON2, CORRUPTION, CUPOFJOE, DELAY, DELAYGUARDS, DOUBLEDIGITS, DOUBLEEVOLUTION, EASTERSPRINGTRAP, EGG, ENNARD, ENUMAELISH, EXTENDEDMAINT, FALL25, FALLENDSSOON, FALLENKINGDOM, FATEUPDATE, FAZRATINGPRESTIGE, FREEDOM, FREEDOMSCALL, FREEDOMSCALLPART2, HALLOWEENWASLASTMONTH, HAPPYEASTER, HAPPYHOLIDAYS, HAPPYNEWYEAR, HEAVENORHELL, HEROESANDVILLAINS, HORSERACING, IAMTHEONEWHODECIDES, INNOCENTANGER, ITSCOLD, KABOOM!, LATE, LATECUSTOMLEVEL, LATEUPDATE, LATEUPDATESORRY, LOLBIT, LORDSHADOW, LOTSOFPRESENTS!, MEMORIA, MOONLESS, NEWLOBBY!, NOCUSTOMS, NOTLONELY, ODYSSEYFIX, ONEINAVANGUARDILLION, OOPS, PART7, PINKVILLAINRAID, PVP, PYSEPHBIRTHDAY, RELEASE, ROST10K, SALTERBOSS, SALVAGE, SASAGEYO, SEASONOFLOVE, SHIBUYA, SLAYER, SORRY4BUGS, SORRY4SHUTDOWN, SORRYFORBUGS, SPRING, STANDPROUD, STEELBALL, SUMMER, SUPERCOMPUTER, SUPERHERO, THEONE, THESTRONGEST, THESYSTEM, THEWORLD, THXFOR1MLIKES, TIKTOK50K, TOURNAMENTBUG, TURBONICLEGRANDMA, UNENDINGRAGE, UNTILTHENISTHEBESTGAME, UPDATE1, UPDATE22, UPDATE24, UPDATE25, UPDATE26, UPDATE27, UPDATE28, UPDATE29, UPDATE3!, VANGUARDSVSSKELETONS, WECURSESHAVENOLIMITS, WHYISTHISNOTWORKING????????, WINTER26, WINTERUPDATESOON, YT200K

What is Anime Vanguards?

Anime Vanguards is a Roblox tower defense game where you collect, and upgrade characters inspired by big name anime. I build a squad, drop units on the path, and try to keep the base safe as the waves stack up. Simple loop. Surprisingly tense. You place, you time skills, you chase that next upgrade.

New abilities unlock as you progress, and regular updates plus weekend events keep things lively. I usually play on my iPhone, then hop to the iPad for longer sessions. Codes help a lot, quick boosts like gems, coins, and trait rerolls when you need them.

How Do Codes Work in Anime Vanguards?

  1. Gems: Used to summon new characters.
  2. Coins/Gold: For upgrades and purchases.
  3. Trait Rerolls: Change your characters’ traits for better stats.
  4. Stat Chips & Essence Stones: Boost your units’ abilities.
  5. Event Items: Special items are only available for a limited time.

Note: Some codes may require your account to reach a specific level before redemption.

How to Redeem Codes in Anime Vanguards?

Redeeming codes is quick and easy. Follow these steps:

  1. Launch Anime Vanguards on Roblox.
  2. Look for the Codes icon—usually a purple button on the right side of the screen or sidebar.
  3. Click the Codes icon to open the code entry window.
  4. Type or paste your code into the “Enter code…” field. Make sure there are no extra spaces and that the code is entered exactly as shown.
  5. Click the Redeem Code button. If the code is valid and you meet any level requirements, your rewards will be added to your account automatically.

Pro Tip: Copy and paste codes directly from trusted sources to avoid typos.

Advanced Troubleshooting Code Redemption Issues

AQuick fixes first, deeper checks second. I run these on iPhone and iPad, then verify once in a desktop browser. 

  • Double check the code: Case sensitive, every character must match. I paste from Notes, then tap backspace to clear a hidden newline from Discord. 
  • Check for extra spaces: Trim spaces before you hit Redeem. iOS sometimes adds one after a prediction, tiny thing that breaks entry. 
  • Confirm code status: Many codes are time limited or tied to events. Check the timestamp where you found it, then retry on a fresh server. 
  • Meet level requirements: Some codes only trigger after you reach a level or clear a tutorial. I use an alt on iPad to confirm a gate before giving up. 
  • Stable connection: Unstable network means unstable redemption. Toggle Wi Fi, cycle mobile data, and turn off Low Data Mode. 
  • Try a different device or browser: If the app errors or ignores input, force quit and relaunch. Still stuck, switch devices or try a desktop browser. 
  • Check for server maintenance or outages: Sudden failures can mean maintenance. Peek at the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Busy lobbies can be flaky. 
  • Update your game client: Install the latest build. Older clients misbehave. A clean reinstall also clears stale data that blocks forms. 
  • Account restrictions: Rare, but Screen Time or family settings can block entry. Review device limits, then check Roblox account settings. 
  • Contact support with evidence: If a valid code still fails, capture a screenshot or short screen recording. Include server, platform, and time. 

Expert insight: During major updates or live events, the code service can lag behind the game. If a new code will not validate, wait a few hours, then try again. 

If you tried all of the above and the code still will not be redeemed, it is likely expired or already at its usage limit. 

You may like to read: Best short anime to watch instead of One Piece

Where to Find More Anime Vanguards Codes?

Stay ahead by checking these official and reliable sources for new codes:

  1. Official Discord Server: Join the Anime Vanguards Discord and monitor the #announcements channel for the latest codes and news.
  2. Official Twitter: Follow @AnimeVanguards for updates and code drops.
  3. Game’s Roblox Page: Sometimes codes are posted in the game’s description or update logs.
  4. YouTube/Twitch: Some content creators and streamers reveal exclusive codes during live events.

Warning: Avoid using codes from unofficial or suspicious sources to keep your account safe.

Additional Free Rewards (Beyond Codes)

Besides codes, Anime Vanguards offers other ways to claim free rewards:

  1. Mailbox Rewards: Occasionally, the developers send out gifts (like Phoenix Shards or Elemental Shards) via the in-game mailbox. Click the Mailboxbutton (usually bottom-right), select new mail, and click Claim or Claim All.
  2. Daily Login Bonuses: Log in each day to earn free gems, coins, or other resources.
  3. Special Events: Participate in limited-time events for exclusive rewards.

Stay Ahead in Anime Vanguards

Anime Vanguards codes are my shortcut to faster upgrades, stronger units, and the odd exclusive that saves a run. I grab them while they are live, paste from Notes on my iPhone, then test on iPad if a pop up stalls. Keep an eye on the game’s official channels for fresh drops and patch notes. When a wave spikes, those freebies matter. Small boosts. Real wins. 

Bookmark this page and keep it handy in Safari. I keep it pinned next to the Discord link, then I pop back to check new codes before a session. Come back often and stay ahead. 

Visit the updated Roblox game codes list for the newest rewards.

FAQs

How often are new codes released?

New codes usually land during big updates, community milestones, or limited events. I check weekly, then again right after a patch. Quick sweep.

Are codes region-locked?

No. Anime Vanguards codes are available globally.

Can I reuse expired codes?

No. Once a code expires it will not be redeemed again. Even if it worked earlier for someone else, the window closes.

Can I redeem codes on mobile?

Yes, codes can be redeemed on both PC and mobile devices.

What should I do if a code doesn’t work?

Check spelling, confirm any level requirement, and verify the code is still valid. Make sure your connection is stable. Then see troubleshooting above.

Are there level requirements for some codes?

Yes. A few codes require a specific account level, and we note that next to each affected code.

What if I encounter a unique code issue?

Share details in the comments or on our Discord. Include a screenshot or short screen recording. Your note can help others, and we will update the guide.

Check out more Roblox codes:

  • Roblox Promo Codes
  • Dress to Impress Codes
  • How to Redeem a Roblox Gift Card
  • How to Cancel Roblox Premium Subscription
  • Anime Defenders Codes

title.rendered: Parkour Champions Codes (June 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Parkour Champions Codes on June 01, 2026

Parkour Champions is a fast-paced, anime-styled obstacle racing game on Roblox where movement is everything. You sprint, wall-run, jump, and glide through intense courses using abilities inspired by iconic anime champions.

This is where Parkour Champions codes come in. These free rewards give you coins, Champion Spins, Spirit Spins, and Super Spins, helping you unlock stronger champions and progress faster without heavy grinding.

Below, you’ll find a verified list of working codes, step-by-step redemption instructions, and tips to find new codes before they expire.

Latest Working Parkour Champions Codes

  • UPD1: 3 Super Champ, 3 Super Enchant Spins and 25,000 coins (NEW)

Expired Parkour Champions Codes

100K, DELAYCHAMPIONS, LAUNCH, LOVE, PARKOUR, PRESENT, RELEASE, SANTA, SEEUSOON, TEST2, THANKU, WELCOME

What Are Parkour Champions Codes?

Parkour Champions codes are free promotional rewards released by the developer, Studio 8K, to help players progress faster.

These codes give useful in-game items like coins, Champion Spins, Spirit Spins, and Super Spins. Coins are used for upgrades and enchants, while spins help you unlock new champions and spirits, with Super Spins offering better chances at top-tier units.

New codes are usually released during game launches, major updates, bug fixes, milestones, and community events. Each code is time-limited and can only be redeemed once per account, so it’s best to claim them as soon as they go live.

How to Redeem Parkour Champions Codes

Redeeming codes in Parkour Champions is simple, but you must complete or skip the tutorial first.

Once you’re in the game, follow these steps carefully.

  1. Launch Parkour Champions on Roblox.
  2. Complete or skip the tutorial.
  3. Click the Codes button at the bottom of the screen.
  4. Enter a working code in the text box.
  5. Press Claim Code.

Valid codes add rewards instantly to your inventory.

If you enjoy games like this, check out our latest Anime Crusaders codes, Hunty Zombie codes, and All Demonfall codes for more free rewards and boosts.

Tips for Finding New Parkour Champions Codes

New codes don’t follow a fixed schedule, so knowing where to look is key.

  • Bookmark reliable Parkour Champions code pages and check them regularly.
  • Revisit code sources after every game update or announcement.
  • Watch for codes shared during milestones and special events.
  • Copy and paste codes instead of typing to avoid errors.
  • Redeem codes as soon as you find them before they expire.

Follow Official Channels for Code Updates

Official channels are the fastest and most reliable source for new Parkour Champions codes.

  • Join the Parkour Champions Discord server for instant announcements and code drops.
  • Follow the Studio 8K Roblox group to stay updated on milestones and updates.
  • Check the official social links listed on the game’s Roblox page.

Alternatively, you can just bookmark this page and check it. We update this page when new codes are listed by the developers.

Join Gaming Communities for Extra Rewards

Joining the Parkour Champions Discord helps you stay connected and improve faster.

  • Early access to new and unreleased codes.
  • Discord-exclusive rewards and giveaways.
  • Gameplay tips from experienced and competitive players.
  • Update news, sneak peeks, and developer announcements.

At times, invite-based exclusive codes are shared that reward players for bringing friends into the server. Staying active increases your chances of grabbing these limited bonuses before anyone else.

Common Issues and How to Fix Them

If a code doesn’t work, it’s usually due to a small and easily fixable issue.

  • Typing errors: Always copy and paste codes exactly as shown
  • Case sensitivity: Codes must match uppercase and lowercase letters perfectly
  • Expired codes: Time-limited codes stop working once they expire
  • Already redeemed: Each code can only be used once per account
  • Tutorial not completed: The Codes button appears only after skipping or finishing the tutorial

Fixing these issues resolves most redemption problems.

Conclusion

Parkour Champions codes are one of the fastest ways to progress and unlock powerful champions without excessive grinding.

Because codes expire quickly, redeem them as soon as they release and check back often for updates.

FAQs

How often are new Parkour Champions codes released?

There is no fixed schedule. New codes are released during updates, milestones, and community events, sometimes multiple times a month.

Can expired Parkour Champions codes be reused?

No. Once a code expires or is redeemed, it cannot be used again. The only solution is to wait for new codes from the developers.

In case you missed

  • Arise Ragnarok Codes
  • Ghoul Re Codes
  • Dungeon Hunters Codes
  • Dueling Grounds Codes
  • Anime Final Quest Codes

title.rendered: iOS 28 rumors surface before Apple even unveils iOS 27

content.rendered:
Apple may already be looking beyond iOS 27. According to Mark Gurman, the company expects iOS 28 to be a much bigger release than next year’s update.

First iOS 28 rumor is already here

In his Power On newsletter, Gurman says Apple’s 2027 software releases are expected to be more ambitious than the updates arriving in 2026.

Internally, Apple is reportedly using the codename “Bell” for iOS 28 and ‘Poppy” for macOS 28.

The timing of the report is notable because Apple hasn’t even unveiled iOS 27 yet. Hearing that the following year’s update could be more significant suggests the company may already be planning larger software changes beyond its current Apple Intelligence roadmap.

The timing is also interesting because iOS 28 is expected to debut alongside Apple’s redesigned 20th-anniversary iPhone. Major iPhone redesigns have often been accompanied by software experiences built around new hardware capabilities, which may explain why Apple is reportedly placing greater importance on the update internally.

iOS 27 will focus heavily on Siri and Apple Intelligence

While iOS 28 remains a mystery, iOS 27 is expected to focus largely on upgrades to Siri and Apple Intelligence.

Apple is reportedly working on a more personalized Siri experience with on-screen awareness and better context understanding across apps like Mail and Messages.

The update is also expected to introduce:

  • A dedicated Siri app for back-and-forth conversations
  • Improved natural language understanding
  • A new “Search or Ask” experience in the Dynamic Island

Many of the features expected in iOS 27 were originally previewed earlier but were delayed before launch. As a result, iOS 27 is expected to focus more on delivering previously announced Apple Intelligence features rather than introducing an entirely new direction for the platform.

These additions are expected to make Siri feel more conversational and more aware of what users are doing across apps.

Apple will officially unveil iOS 27 during WWDC 2026 on June 8, while iOS 28 will likely be introduced at WWDC 2027. Until then, Apple’s plans for iOS 28 remain largely unknown beyond Gurman’s suggestion that it could be a far more ambitious release.

Do you expect iOS 28 to bring a major redesign? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

title.rendered: NBA 2K26 Locker Codes (June 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest NBA 2K26 Locker Codes on June 04, 2026

If you play NBA 2K26 regularly, you already know how slow progress can feel without packs, boosts, or VC. That’s where locker codes come in. They are the easiest way to get free rewards without grinding for hours or spending money. The catch is simple: they don’t last long, and if you miss them, they’re gone.

All active NBA 2k26 locker codes

  • HALI-GAME-1: Invincible Tyrese Haliburton (NEW)
  • FREE-BOOSTS: 3 Games of Boosts (Skills and Gatorade)

That’s the only active code at the moment, but new ones can drop anytime. 2K releases them randomly, so the list can change quickly.

Expired NBA 2K26 locker codes

2K-26-CREATOR-CHALLENGE, 2K26-MYTEAM-GAME-CHANGERS, ALL-STAR-NO-LIMIT, ALL-STAR-PACK-MT, BALL-OVER-EVERYTHING-0383-0877, BALL-OVER-EVERYTHING-3178-4640, BALL-OVER-EVERYTHING-5128-2959, BALL-OVER-EVERYTHING-60576581, BALL-OVER-EVERYTHING-6110-5004, BALL-OVER-EVERYTHING-8485-8260, BAM-83-POINTS, BEASTS-IN-MT-2K26, BOUNCE-MT-2K26, DELUXE-PACK-BALL-DROP, DROSE-AND-JERSEYS-SHOES, FLAGG-CURRY-MYTEAM, FOX-AND-SGA-IN-MT, FREE-WIN-IN-MYTEAM, HAPPY-HOLIDAYS-FROM-MYTEAM, MLK-DAY-MYTEAM, MT-CERTIFIED-2K26, MT-CHILLS-WILD-GEMS, MT-EDWARDS-AND-JOKIC, MT-HALLOWEEN, MT-HOLIDAY-BANNER, MT-LIN-DM-EVENT-CARD-LNY, MT-MITCHELL-BRUNSON, MT-PINK-DIAMOND-JALEN-JOHNSON, MT-ST-PATRICKS, MT-SWIFT-DROP, MT-THANKSGIVING, MYCAREER-MLK-DAY-2026, MYTEAM-ALUMNI, MYTEAM-KD-DONCIC, NBA-PIONEERS, NBA-TIP-OFF-IN-MYTEAM, PD-EVENT-CARD-VALENTINE, WNBA-IN-MYTEAM

How to redeem NBA 2K26 locker codes

Redeeming codes is simple, but if you’ve never done it before, it can feel slightly hidden inside menus. Here’s exactly what to do.

  1. Open NBA 2K26
  2. Go to MyTeam mode.
  3. Navigate to the Market tab.
  4. Scroll to Locker Codes.
  5. Enter the code exactly (including dashes).
  6. Press Done and claim your reward.
    • Image Credit: 2K Games

Once redeemed, the rewards are added instantly to your account.

What you get from locker codes

Locker codes are not just small bonuses. Sometimes they can completely change your progress. You can get:

  • Free VC
  • MyTeam player cards (including high-rated players)
  • Packs
  • MyPlayer clothing and gear
  • Skill and Gatorade boosts
  • XP boosts
  • Coach items and cosmetics

Some drops are minor, like boosts, but others can give you strong players early and save hours of grinding.

How to get more NBA 2K26 locker codes

This is where most players struggle. Codes don’t come from one place — they are scattered across multiple platforms.

2K usually releases them on:

  • Official NBA 2K MyTeam X (Twitter) account
  • TikTok
  • Community Discord server
  • NBA and WNBA broadcasts

Keeping track manually is messy. The easiest approach is to bookmark this page and check it often. We update it as soon as new codes arrive, so you don’t miss short-lived drops.

Why your NBA 2K26 locker code is not working

If a code fails, it’s usually one of these common issues.

  • The code has expired
  • You entered it incorrectly (especially missing dashes)
  • You already redeemed it before

If everything looks correct and it still doesn’t work, your last option is contacting 2K support.

What is a locker code?

A locker code is a limited-time text code released by 2K that you can enter inside the game to claim free rewards. These are usually tied to events, promotions, or seasonal drops.

The key detail is timing. Most codes stay active for only a few days to a week, which is why staying updated matters more than anything else.

Final thoughts

Locker codes in NBA 2K26 are one of those small things that make a big difference. You don’t feel it instantly, but over time, the free boosts, packs, and players stack up and give you a real advantage.

Right now, the list is short, but that’s normal. Codes come and go quickly. The players who benefit the most are the ones who check often and redeem fast.

If you don’t want to miss future drops, keep this page bookmarked and check back regularly — new codes can appear at any time.
